profile.label: Imprisoned count
profile.value: One less time than Fenrir (self claimed)

10101101.introduction: Movme Bellows, Electric Eel freelancer. Loyal to Frida and hates Fenrir's guts. Shady past. Sly, greedy coward with no morals or ambition. Classic bottom-feeder.

stories.title: Juvenile Delinquent
stories.text: "Movme Bellows, male, 17 years old, parents deceased. On the morning of May 19th, he caused an altercation on the streets of White Maple, resulting in two minor injuries. Since his detention, he has confessed to his crime. According to Article 53, Section 4 of the Criminal Law of the Union of Northern Continental States, he is sentenced to two years for intentional harm." — White Maple City Supreme Court

comment.text: The offender has shown resistance to discipline, has performed labor duties unwillingly, showed no remorse while serving his rehabilitation sentence, and was twice placed in solitary confinement.

stories.title: The End of Innocence
stories.text: "Movme Bellows, male, 28 years old, was admitted to our hospital on August 16th with shoulder penetration wounds, scalp lacerations, and numerous other injuries. Our hospital has been commissioned by the NDF to assess the extent of his injuries. The evaluation concludes that the injuries are classified as level one light injuries. After treatment, the patient is out of danger and has been handed over to the NDF for further handling." — Rayneburg University Medical Center

comment.text: That kid's asking for it! He gets a couple of insults thrown his way and decides to throw down with a guy in uniform? He deserves whatever he gets!

stories.title: Electric Eel Cohort
stories.text: [Movme, age unknown, biography unknown. Specializes in stealing and fighting. Poor psychological resilience, prone to losing control under pressure. Introduced by the chief to join the Southern Detachment after Operation 503, under the direct management of the chief. Commission to be determined.] — Electric Eel Mercenary Regiment Information Registration Form

stories.title: External Member
stories.text: [I, Movme, am out of the Electric Eel! From now on, I ain't takin' orders from Frida no more, and I'm cutting ties from Fenrir and the whole damn mercenary crew! If we ever link up again, the money's gotta be straight—count it in person, for crying out loud! I stand by my word, no turning back!] — Electric Eel Mercenaries File Book

comment.text: This kid says he's out of the organization, but he's still following the boss around, nodding his head and kissing up all day long!

10101102.introduction: Pacific Corp's most punctual guard. Could be Employee of the Month if he weren't such a slacker. He keeps to himself unless you want to talk to STs.

stories.title: Area A   Checked
stories.text: Adrien, a Pacific Company security guard, was originally a mercenary. He was quiet and lacked motivation, and even when he occasionally did speak, it was only to talk about work with his colleagues. His work ethic wasn't exactly stellar, but at least he completed his tasks on time. Compared to other pilots on this island, he's the definition of a man who keeps to himself.

comment.text: Adrien's meticulous in his work—the guy never makes mistakes. And hey, if the boss says it's fine, who's to say otherwise?

stories.title: Logistics Area      Checked
stories.text: During breaks, Adrien usually retreats to a quiet spot to eat alone, never initiating conversation with anyone. But from what his colleagues have said, he's actually quite likeable. Someone once asked him out of curiosity why he eats alone, but he casually brushed them off, saying it merely saves him energy.

stories.title: Monitoring Room      Checked
stories.text: Adrien may seem indifferent to the world, but he surprisingly has a fondness for reading. His favorite genre is anything related to mechs, followed closely by nonfiction. Of course, he's flipped through pretty much every book in the break room. Occasionally, others ask to borrow books from him. As long as they don't dog-ear the pages, he's usually fine with it.

comment.text: Most of the books in his collection are about STs or the real-life events of Milkhama Island, but still, he gives the impression of being completely unrelated to all that.

stories.title: Entrance      Checked
stories.text: Even on his days off, Adrien mostly stays at home. This island attracts many ambitious people, some of whom are naturally curious about why he's here. He's not entirely indifferent, though, as seen from the piles of books scattered around his room—an indication of his keen interest in Arashium technology and the new generation of STs.

10101103.introduction: Ask Ashes about Chloe Schmidt, they'll say she is a dedicated medic and a tough captain. Ask Yevgeny, he'll call her a true warrior. Ask her? Just a smile and "who knows" as she works.

stories.title: Schmidt Clinic
stories.text: When I was a kid, playing in the clinic my parents ran together was what I looked forward to most. Occasionally, when there were no patients to be seen, my dad would hold me in one arm while reading me obscure medical books that were far difficult for me to understand. I would laugh at his scribbled annotations. When the clinic was crowded, my mom would place me at the desk, tell the nurse to keep an eye on me, and then turn around to join my dad.

stories.title: Mission Improbable
stories.text: That night, the DL's target was a military base on the outskirts of White Maple City. My mother carried me to the shelter on an armored vehicle, holding me tightly as I cried. She told me that she and my father had a mission to complete. I refused to let go of her clothes... until she handed me a cold, sharp military knife. "Take it, Chloe. It will protect you when we can't, but remember—a knife can both harm and save people." These were my mother's last words to me.

stories.title: Twisted Fate
stories.text: Afterward, I became a neutral doctor, treating all the civilians who came to me for help. I lived my life in a daze until one early morning, a group of guys wearing UNCS uniforms rushed into my clinic and took me back to the military camp without any explanation. I refused to treat anyone from the UNCS, so they locked me up and cut off my food supply. I thought it was the end for me—as I was starving to death. Then I heard gunshots, and the cell door opened. I struggled to lift my head and saw a long-haired man with a fierce look standing out in the hall.

stories.title: Destined Military Doctor
stories.text: Captain Chloe, Dr. Chloe... that's what the warriors of The Ashes call me. They come from all corners of Milkhama, most of them few with words to say. Still, they express their kindness in their own way—finely tuned STs, new medicines from unknown sources, a spotless clinic... Perhaps The Ashes will become my new home, I sometimes silently think to myself.

10101104.introduction: Pip Beswick, mystery bounty hunter. Music lover, born wanderer. Free spirit who treats bounties like shopping lists. The moral compass spins differently. Oddly fixated on Kaidan's GKD.

stories.title: Forgotten Homeland
stories.text: The first time I did someone's dirty work for them was around thirteen years old. It wasn't a glamorous job, but I still remember that woman's blue eyes. Damn, they were mesmerizing... After that, business picked up, with regulars coming in and out. Then... well, there was that time I was working to some tunes, and without thinking, I made a mistake and got rid of someone important. Had to pack up and leave in a hurry that night. Honestly, I can't even remember how old I was when I left the country. Eh... whatever, that stuff doesn't matter anymore. ♪

stories.title: Cavalry Hunter
stories.text: I love the wandering pilot guild in Milkhama! Although they kept laughing while processing my paperwork, they gave me a good list and taught me how to operate an ST! Oh, I love Milkhama's STs! Sitting in the cockpit, the people under my feet are as cute and helpless as little cats and dogs. With the 360-degree surround sound, I can zip through missions with a swoosh! Post-war Milkhama is such a great place! ♪

comment.text: When asked for his name, this kid just glanced at an old newspaper posted on the wall and answered without thinking. Hahaha, "Pip" and "Beswick"? Those two kicked the can just recently!

stories.title: Superficial Success
stories.text: These days, mercenary squads of all sizes are popping up all over the island, offering everything from A to Z. They've even started snatching up the big orders I used to get, leaving me with only the small stuff. And don't get me started on those so-called legit logistics companies—they might look above board, but they're secretly gunning for my business too! Kid, honestly, I wouldn't mind if things got even more chaotic around here. At least that way I could rake in some serious cash, hahaha...♪

stories.title: Enchanting Chaos
stories.text: Now things are getting interesting! Lately, there's been a real buzz in Milkhama, with rebels stirring things up and the NDF making big moves. Word is, the new recruits who took down the UNCS's Valkyrie are hanging around the jungle area. They've even set up a pretty solid logistics company and are running their own show! Woohoo♪! I'd love to cross paths with those guys if I get the chance!

10101105.introduction: Kaylen Evans, UNCS Coast Guard, claims top connections. Greedy coward who hates combat. Dreams of cashing out and leaving Milkhama rich.

stories.title: A Thousand Names
stories.text: I simply cannot stand it when people try to give me these animal-based nicknames. It's nothing short of an indirect insult! I've done absolutely nothing to provoke anyone at school—I've merely used my resources, as any sensible person would. And yet, behind my back, they refer to me as a "yellow rat" or a "stinking fox." It's totally unreasonable!

comment.text: This scoundrel, huh... When he became a member of the student council, he collected lunch money from everyone—and he dared to call it a "campus development fee"!

stories.title: Desired Location
stories.text: Why join the NDF? For the money, of course. Why come to Milkhama? Someone told me there's money to be made all over this place. Hmph... that being said, when I actually arrived here, I realized I was too late—the smart ones had already taken the best positions, and all that was left was scraps.

stories.title: Complex Connections
stories.text: After all these years, I finally climbed to my current position with the help of that big shot! What I need to do next is establish connections with everyone in the coastal defense army and then wait for the money to come rolling in! I've done my research—there's not a single tough nut to crack here. If I spend a little cash and offer some minor perks, golden days are finally coming my way!

stories.title: Brewing Defection
stories.text: The seas have been getting rough lately, and I keep getting dragged into combat missions. Tch... If it weren't for the pressure, I wouldn't step foot on a battlefield at all! That big shot is planning some large-scale action that could threaten the governor. Maybe it's time to seize this chance, switch sides, and join the governor's faction with all the intel I possess?

comment.text: Hmm? Wait, could the important guy he's talking about be...?

10101106.introduction: Ovett merchant runs booze and more to Milkhama. Plays the loud friendly trader, deals on profit not politics. Done jobs with GKD. Really a sharp operator working for Ovett's comeback.

stories.title: Foreign Merchant
stories.text: When I first came to Milkhama, everyone I did business with would ask me curiously why an Ovettian would travel all the way here. I could never give a solid answer, and would just brush it off with a "I came to make money." That was until one night, barely keeping my head together after pulling an all-nighter, I muttered out, "To revive Ovett"... Hah, who would have thought those words would come out of my mouth? But from that moment on, I thought, maybe taking this idea seriously wasn't such a bad thing after all.

stories.title: Booming Business
stories.text: After business picked up, I formed connections with more prominent organizations. I began selling Ovett's specialty drinks and products to the local elite who indulge in such pleasures. I also purchased rare local items to bring back with me, like α ore and Arashium alloy. While the UNCS and DL impose strict restrictions on these goods, Milkhama isn't fully under their control... On this island, things are far more accessible, depending on how deep your pockets run.

comment.text: Although that's true, Arashium alloy isn't something you can easily obtain just by throwing money at it. This old man definitely has some hidden connections no one knows about!

stories.title: Storm
stories.text: Traveling between the cities of the two superpowers, even those who are indifferent to the current situation should have noticed the propaganda of the NDF has increased significantly compared to previous years, the trade of resources such as metal and medicine is constantly being restricted, and the scrutiny of cross-border transportation has blatantly increased... The peace that has been maintained for nearly a decade may be about to change. Therefore, I have decided to develop trade relations with other forces I've never engaged with before. Even if I can't avoid the storm, at least I'll know which way the wind is blowing.

stories.title: Penetration
stories.text: The "GKD Parcel Service," especially that young man named "Kaidan Newman," has made quite a splash, despite only a few brief collaborations. Now, the UNCS, the DL, and even the mysterious Obsidian Group have started to take action against them. Even the underground mercenaries and merchants occasionally discuss events linked to them... The powder keg hidden on this island might just be about to be lit by those renegades.

10101107.introduction: Lily Stan, DLAF peacekeeping captain. Battle-hardened White Rose, troops trust her completely. Total faith in DLAF bringing peace to every corner of Milkhama.

stories.title: Cum Laude
stories.text: Whenever Lily Stan is mentioned, both the faculty and students at the military academy can't help but show a rare, relaxed smile and say a few words of praise. In drills, she's a brave and skilled soldier; during preparations, she's a meticulous and thoughtful squad leader; on leave, she's an understanding woman. As she puts it, the Dawnstar League symbolizes the flag of freedom, which always flies proudly in her heart.

stories.title: Determination
stories.text: Joining the peacekeeping forces and being stationed on Milkhama was Lily's choice after graduating. She could never forget the scene when she first set foot on the island—the city, still recovering from shelling, was in the midst of reconstruction, while refugees wandered aimlessly through the ruins, heads lowered, and distant cries of children echoing in the background. In that moment, Lily vowed to save this place and support the Dawnstar League in bringing lasting peace to the island.

comment.text: Senior Officer Lily, the "White Rose" of our forces!

stories.title: Resident
stories.text: Peacekeeping proved to be even more challenging than Lily had anticipated. Although the so-called war had officially ended years ago, occasional small-scale conflicts still threatened civilian survival, and refugee camps often faced shortages of essential supplies. Most of the soldiers who came to Milkhama with her had already returned home, but Lily refused to sign the redeployment order.

comment.text: I really don't understand what's so good about that island! I wish I'd never set foot in that damn place!

stories.title: Abide
stories.text: Lately, rumors have been circulating through the military, causing Lily to worry even more about the island's future. The current peace will be shattered, and a new war will come. She has a gut feeling that there's some truth behind these whispers, and the recent troop deployments from the DLAF to Milkhama only seem to confirm her fears. But despite it all, she'll continue to hold on until the ideal peace arrives.

10101108.introduction: Jon Brewster, ex-NDF merc. War broke him. Lost too many friends. Now works the Northwest jungle. Known for keeping his word—rare for a merc in these parts.

stories.title: Mercenary Era
stories.text: Jon is by no means a desperado. In his mind, there is a clear hierarchy: first is his own life, followed by his companions, and lastly, money. Following this philosophy, Jon has led his teammates on the battlefield countless times to survive in desperate situations without making choices he might regret.

comment.text: Hell yeah! Surviving is the only shot you've got! Sure, the outsiders love to look down on the mercenary code, but to me? That's the number one rule for staying alive. What do you think, boss?

stories.title: Partner
stories.text: That said, not all his comrades would make it out unscathed. In the dead of night, Jon would see their faces. Many of them were forced to step onto the front lines for the sake of their families or survival, carrying hopes for the future but ultimately perishing in the dust. He'll never forget the burden his companions carried for a slim chance at peace. He must survive, along with their share, to welcome peace on Milkhama Island.

comment.text: Yeah... You can't stay lost in sorrow forever. They handed their lives over to us... so it's on us to carry their part and see the right future unfold!

stories.title: Money
stories.text: People often say, "Money makes the world go round," and Jon couldn't agree more. Especially in these unstable times, making money is far more practical than worrying about appearances. It's not that he's obsessed with wealth—if you ask him why he wants to make money, he'll tell you: money is the only thing that might buy him a little peace of mind.

stories.title: War and Peace
stories.text: After the border war, Jon tried his hand at jobs outside of being a mercenary, but now, he's back in that familiar cockpit. The main reason he returned to the battlefield was his comrades. He couldn't bear to watch the ravaged land again, nor could he stand the thought of others sacrificing themselves for him.

10101109.introduction: DL trucker hauls anything for a price. Quiet but fierce, personally fought off hijackers multiple times. Senses the storm coming to Milkhama. Planning his survival and escape route home.

stories.title: April 2, XC 104, Sunny
stories.text: "In the second year after I came to Milkhama, I was sent to prison. The charge was intentional injury, with the court ruling that I had severely injured a person I had never even met before... I pleaded guilty but denied all accusations linking the incident to my boss. A large sum of money also appeared in my parents' account back in my distant hometown—just as I had agreed with my boss. This was my decision, and what I had to do... was to spend seven years of my life here."

stories.title: August 3, XC 109, Cloudy
stories.text: "I was released from prison two years earlier than initially planned... I heard that my boss's true colors were revealed, and the truth came out, leading to my acquittal. As I left, the prison was abuzz. Some were cursing loudly, others sighing in relief. I understood what they were thinking—resenting the heavy lessons I'd handed out to every troublemaker, yet also afraid of the dozens of terrifying scars on my body."

comment.text: I find it really hard to believe he's innocent. If you'd seen him beating up those problem prisoners without uttering so much as a word, you'd agree with me too.

stories.title: January 21, XC 116, Heavy Rain
stories.text: "I've been running private goods transport for years, and it's obvious my regular routes are becoming less and less safe. It used to be just some local bullies looking to intercept shipments, but now I'm seeing entire squads of rebels, commanding military-grade STs. On top of that, security checkpoints are popping up more and more along the way... With the weight and those complex anti-demagnetization, fire-resistant containers, I know I can't afford to be careless with the stuff I'm hauling in this truck of mine."

stories.title: April 15, XC 118, Cloudy
stories.text: "Weapons, medicine, intelligence, human resources... they're not only circulating within the DL, but more and more are being sent to the UNCS and even the rebels. Many of my acquaintances have recognized the danger and left the industry, causing prices to climb higher and higher. This is good news for me... Even if Milkhama is on the brink of a new war, it's nothing to do with me. All I need to do is make enough money and return to my homeland."

10101110.introduction: Ovett native. Enfield Academy grad. All business, all study. Topped tech theory and became Winston's apprentice. Now, it helps research bio-mech fusion.

stories.title: August 17, XC 111, Sunny
stories.text: "Today's the day of the research institute visit! I was so excited I barely slept all night and left early in the morning. I begged the researcher to take me to areas off-limits to students. I was completely mesmerized by the prototype machines locked behind bulletproof glass, staring at them for so long that I didn't even notice someone standing behind me. 'Would you be interested in pursuing research in this field?' the person asked with a smile. Of course, I nodded eagerly. But, I wonder... who was that person?"

stories.title: February 16, XC 113, Rain
stories.text: "Failed again... If I could, I'd skip every single class related to ST combat. I don't think I'll ever understand why those guys in military school are so obsessed with it. Sweating like crazy... It's honestly the most boring thing I can imagine! At least tomorrow we've got a theory exam... Phew, I guess I really do prefer wearing a white coat and working with machines."

comment.text: If possible, I want to be a hacker who only deals with data...

stories.title: July 8, XC 117, Rain
stories.text: "Today marks exactly one week since I arrived at the Winston Research Institute. Though I had heard of the renowned Dr. Winston before, I couldn't help but marvel when I saw the prototypes made from Arashium alloy. It's a shame Dr. Newman, the initiator of this research, is no longer around. Progress could've been even faster if he were still here. If only I could learn everything and take this technology back with me..."

stories.title: September 25, XC 117, Cloudy
stories.text: "Our research has encountered an unprecedented bottleneck. The higher-ups are very dissatisfied with our progress, and Dr. Winston always has a furrowed brow. I heard that the situation outside remains unstable. Today, I even received an encrypted email from the NDF telling us to 'be ready to move at any time.' What will the future hold...? How much longer can 'she' wait for me...?"

comment.text: Huh? "She"...? Are you talking about your own mother?

10102101.introduction: They call her "Captain of the Northwest." Harvey has the skill and connections to back it up. She believes in fair deals and stays positive when things go south. After that wild run with Kaidan's crew, she found her path and joined GKD.

stories.title: Port
stories.text: Speaking of ports, I can't help but think back to the strange twist of fate that brought me and the GKD Squad together. The whole thing wasn't exactly a pleasant memory—being mistaken as bait, misunderstandings, and all that... After all these years as a captain in Milkhama, I've never run into this many problems at once! But, well... when I think about that grand finale, I guess working with the GKD Squad isn't all that bad after all!

stories.title: Deck
stories.text: "If the GKD Squad is involved, it's not gonna end well!" I've said it so many times, my mouth's practically worn out, but Kaidan and the others keep shoving these damn jobs my way. Sure, I did mention wanting a few bigger orders... but I didn't sign up for this level of chaos!

comment.text: Whenever you're taking that money, you certainly don't have that frown on your face...

stories.title: Cargo Hold
stories.text: Kaidan and Grant aren't always in happy-go-lucky mode. I've noticed that around a certain time, the three of them suddenly vanish without a trace. When I ask them why, they just say they're visiting an old friend. Later, Grant quietly told me that's a wound they can't touch, a pain they'll never forget. If it's got something to do with this island, I think I can guess some of the reasons. The island may look peaceful, but constantly erupts in conflict—Kaidan and his friends must have lost someone important because of it...

stories.title: Captain's Cabin
stories.text: Alright, let's see what today's order is... Huh, another one for the border. Orders to the other side have been stacking up lately, and they're all weapons or at least something like that. What Kaidan said is true: the illusion of peace in Milkhama might not last much longer. But I'm sure the GKD Squad has already set a plan for the future. When the tides of war are impossible to resist, what's your move gonna be, boss? Guess I'll just have to wait and see.

comment.text: Um...what was our policy again? Oh, right, our "policy" is that there is no policy!

10102102.introduction: "Shawnee Russell, East Milkhama security chief, DLAF rising star. People see law and order. Don't see the iron fist. Opponents quit races early. Watch that sweet smile. It hides teeth." —Naomi's Brief to Arnold

stories.title: Evening Broadcast
stories.text: "Good evening, ladies and gentlemen. Tonight, we introduce Miss Shawnee Russell, the newly appointed security chief of East Milkhama. Since stepping into the political arena last year, Miss Russell has attracted significant attention. Her youth and striking appearance have earned her considerable support, but there are whispers questioning her competence and the potential connections behind her rise. In tonight's program, we'll hear from those closest to her, giving you a closer look at this rising star in Milkhama's political landscape." — DL TV Program "Milkhama News"

stories.title: Teaching Evaluation
stories.text: "Ah... Shawnee has been my student for a long time. As a teacher, my expectations are very high... but Shawnee is a rare kind of polymath... no, more like a genius par excellence. Of course, her family background plays a heavy part in this. After all, her father is also quite a figure within the DL. But don't get me wrong, she's not the kind of spoiled princess who simply rides on her family's coattails. She has a talent that has been carefully nurtured and the awareness to use wisely." — Evaluation of Shawnee by a Well-Known Professor

comment.text: I knew it... Shawnee's hiding something. I'm digging up all her dirt from Skynet before any kind of deal goes down.

stories.title: Peacekeeper
stories.text: "Shawnee... that girl's a freak, the kind that's completely off the rails... Hmph, if you ask me, with that face and figure, she should've gone into modeling, or found some rich playboy to latch onto... Coming to a place like this is a total waste. Of course, her shooting skills, and her nose for solving cases, are flawless... So, I wasn't surprised when she became the head of the Guard Bureau... I just don't get why she's in this line of work." — A Senior Detective from the DL Commenting on Shawnee

stories.title: Future of the League
stories.text: "The pursuit of peace has always been my goal... This has never changed, and of course, I understand that these two words are a luxury on Milkhama. However, the key to the Dawnstar League's ability to take the initiative and achieve a situation of co-governance with the UNCS lies in our expectations for the future and the prudent exercise of our advanced power... Milkhama is shrouded in the fog of war, and there are also voices of agreement within the League... In this regard, I urge you all to reconsider, and I will also represent the position of the security department and take whatever action is necessary." — League Meeting Minutes

comment.text: Well, it's just as I expected. The Dawnstar League isn't the monolithic entity some make it out to be. Miss Russell clearly needs allies who share her interests right now, but how long will this facade of peace conceal her true ambitions?

10102103.introduction: "Emily's too fragile for transfer. But she won't admit it, doesn't want to be a burden. Maybe she's strongest of us all, no strength but never breaks. That's the spirit Epiphyllum needs." —Sylvie's Letter to Hong

stories.title: June, XC 113, Cloudy
stories.text: My parents are always fighting about money and the little things in life. I want to stop them, but they always end up taking it out on me. The way they look at me... it's really scary. I get so scared that I can't say anything back, so I just go back to my room and pray over and over that it'll end soon... But every time they stop fighting and I open the door, all I see is the mess they've made. What should I do...?

stories.title: August, XC 113, Cloudy to Sunny
stories.text: "Mom and Dad haven't been fighting much lately, I think. At first, I wasn't sure, so I just watched them carefully. They still act like they don't want to talk much, but when they see me, they start being all nice. They must've made up! They said I'm just a kid, so I won't understand why. But next week, they're going to take me to meet someone who helped them—was he the one who made Mom and Dad friends again? I want to thank him!"

stories.title: September, XC 113, Rain
stories.text: "Today, Mom told me I can't stay with them anymore. Uncle Winston will take me to a place they say I'll like. I don't really know where it is, but seeing how happy they look, I couldn't help feeling a little excited. They kept saying Uncle Winston's a big help to our family. I've never seen them smile like that before. I hope they're happy after I leave..."

comment.text: Hmph! Winston's just trying to use those hopeless parents to sell their own daughter!

stories.title: February, XC 115, Unknown
stories.text: "How much time has passed since then...? Every time I wake up from a nightmare, I wonder about it, but I can't figure it out. Even when I ask, those uncles and aunties in white just give me such cold answers. My body hurts... it really hurts. Uncle Winston says it's a sign I'm getting stronger, which is good. But what does 'getting stronger' even mean? What am I getting stronger for...? I don't understand what I'm doing. Someone, please... save me."

comment.text: Emily... sorry we're late. It's all over now. No one will ever hurt you again.

10102104.introduction: "Raven Bluecher, Blair's boy. Enfield Academy star, active NDF officer. Media calls him the perfect leader-warrior. Truth? Just daddy's sheltered kid." —Anonymous Cadet

stories.title: Under the Monument
stories.text: When I think of my father, the first thing that comes to mind is what he said to me when I was seven years old, standing beneath the border monument: "You must become a warrior and fight for the UNCS!" As for why he said that, I was too afraid to ask at the time, and now there's no point in asking again.

comment.text: A strict father and a filial son—what a cliché. The idea of being an "obedient child" is bound to shatter sooner or later, for one reason or another...

stories.title: [Bluecher]
stories.text: At the military academy, the Bluecher name is like a heavy crown, reminding me at all times that I have to put in more effort than everyone else to gain genuine recognition from them all. Dana Yano, a young woman who is faultless in every way, always seems to be secretly competing with me. Although chivalry dictates that ladies should be given priority in all things, I won't be stepping aside for her—especially not when it comes to proving myself!

comment.text: The envious and fearful gazes of my classmates, consistently scoring 0.5 points higher than me during assessments, the most promising cadet in the eyes of the instructors... Raven Bluecher, without that last name of yours, none of this would be yours!

stories.title: First Day in the Armored Corps
stories.text: Joining Major Stein's ranks is an honor for any soldier of the Armored Corps! Though Major Stein may seem hard to approach, the strength he shows in both training and combat is exactly what I aspire to. I hope one day to become a pilot as formidable as Major Stein. If I do, my father will finally see me in a new light...

comment.text: "Humanity's strongest," William Stein... He was once one of the leaders I wanted to follow in the footsteps of, but unfortunately...

stories.title: Subordination and Truth
stories.text: Dad's been up to something lately. No... truth is, he's always kept secrets from me. Can't say for sure, but I get the feeling whatever he's working on is tied to this so-called "classified research." What's the real deal here? It doesn't matter—I'm gonna find out for myself if it's the last thing I do.

10102105.introduction:
UNCS council member, a rival to Blair. Dreams of a unified, equal Milkhama. Prepping impeachment under Raven's guard.
Built like a tank under that suit. Clear-eyed about the risks but won't back down from his ideals as things heat up.

stories.title: Evergreen
stories.text: A politician's career is often short-lived, but for Arnold, fifty years feels like too long. Having been active in politics since he was sixteen, dedicating half a century to the peace cause as an anti-war advocate, he no longer has any desire for the power that so many crave. At least now, ten years after the border war ended, Milkhama has become the land of hope people dreamt of.

stories.title: Before Retirement
stories.text: On a summer night, after finishing up an ST battle and rubbing his sore back, Arnold self-deprecatingly said, "Maybe it's time for me to retire." Due to his involvement in the freedom movements of neighboring countries in his early years, Arnold formed an inexplicable bond with mechs. Whether it was old-fashioned SLs or new STs, Arnold could find the purest joy in the collision of cold steel. However, nowadays, Arnold finds it difficult to maneuver mechs as freely as he did when he was young. Now, he's forced to settle for remotely controlled drones as a substitute for his former passion. He thought his later years would unfold quietly like this, but the new governor's order dragged him back into the heart of the storm.

comment.text: Senator Arnold later came up with the idea of delivering speeches while piloting ST. For those outside of Milkhama, there is nothing more captivating than these towering machines of steel.

stories.title: New Deployment Order
stories.text:
Blair Bluecher has been appointed the new Viceroy of the Federal Republic of Milkhama. After the Union Council approved the military's transfer recommendation, Arnold felt like he was waking up from an old dream. Despite the rebel resurgence in the Milkhama region, he never expected that the mastermind behind the "Milthus Explosion Scandal" would be selected as the new Viceroy of West Milkhama.
Cautious as ever, Arnold is aware that Blair's appointment must be part of some larger scheme, and he realizes that his retirement date may have to be postponed once again.

stories.title: Setting Sail for Milkhama
stories.text:
Arnold anticipated that Blair's arrival could improve the situation in Milkhama. Instead, it worsened the already tense border situation and failed to quell the rebel uprising. The seasoned Arnold soon sensed that an unseen hand, hidden behind the shifting power dynamics, was stirring the pot in Milkhama.
With the determination to "not let the tragedy of fifteen years ago repeat itself on Milkhama," Arnold, who had been fighting for peace for fifty years, boarded a ship to the island.

comment.text: Instead of following the regular procedure of visiting the viceroy's office, Senator Arnold opted for independent action with the assistance of a few special agents, starting from Milthus... The security of the upcoming trip to Milkhama will be overseen by the General Security Administration, bypassing the NDF, and we will handle any intelligence security issues!

10102106.introduction: NDF drill instructor. Master of combat and ST tactics. Makes boot camp hell because war's worse. They call her "Devil Instructor," but she's saved more recruits than she's broken. Best Instructor in 3 years of running proves it.

stories.title: A Talent for Combat
stories.text: "Mary, everyone has their own talent, such as singing, dancing, or what have you... You need to find yours and stick with it." My late mother's words echoed in my head as I knocked out a man's tooth for the first time. My hand was wrapped around his neck, flipping his fat body to the ground, watching him fade into unconsciousness from a lack of oxygen. Sirens wailed in the distance. Maybe my talent is fighting and running away, I thought as I fled the scene.

stories.title: Farewell to the Past
stories.text: On Milkhama, there is no history, and the Milkhamans do not even care about history—this is the conclusion I came to in my third year on the island. Even close friends in the NDF do not ask about each other's past. I like this kind of distant relationship, one that separates soldier Mary Rodriguez from the trembling girl hiding in that cabin. It constantly reminds me not to dwell on the past.

comment.text: I remember one time we were out on a business trip and I heard Mary talking in her sleep at night. She had this frown on her face and was shouting, "mom" over and over. Sure, she looks tough, but I bet she had an even tougher childhood she doesn't want anyone to know about.

stories.title: Bloodstained Tag
stories.text: The failure of that mission came at a heavy cost for the entire squad. As the only survivor who remained unscathed and conscious, I wrote a report close to a hundred pages long and, as the NDF's representative, delivered the belongings of our fallen comrades to their families. If our training had been more rigorous and our plans more precise... could they have all made it out alive? Two weeks later, I submitted my application to transfer to a military academy.

comment.text: When she was brought in that day, she was covered in blood and clutching seven or eight military ID tags that didn't belong to her, eyes wider than anything I'd ever seen. It was terrifying...

stories.title: The Devil Instructor
stories.text: "The Devil Instructor"... I know that's what those cadets call me behind my back, but I couldn't care less. I'm not here to make friends, I'm here to make survivors. Strict, hard training is the only way to make sure mistakes don't end in tragedy. I teach them everything I know—solid combat tactics, and when that doesn't work, I teach them how to run like hell. They hate it, they fight it, but they'll thank me later when they're still standing. I'd rather they curse me than end up dead or useless on the battlefield. That's something I remind myself of every day.

10102107.introduction: Ex-7th Mobile Squad under Marcus. Joined the NDF at 16, like her father. Her squad's hardest worker until the White Maple incident got her kicked out. Her time with Kaidan's crew started changing that stubborn streak.

stories.title: A Resume
stories.text:
Anastasia watched the STs rushing to the front lines as a girl. The NDF's propaganda echoed in her ears, telling her that these warriors were fighting gloriously for their families and for peace. However, they never told her when her father would return from the battlefield.
As time passed, the noble beliefs and grand visions in the news became her world. Her father, whom she would never see again, became her goal. Years later, she joined the NDF, swearing to fight for the people and for glory, and to follow in her father's footsteps.

stories.title: A Friend
stories.text:
Ana's extraordinary faith has brought her unwavering perseverance and a fiery personality. The former made her an elite member of the 7th Mobile Squad, while the latter caused friction with some of her teammates. When a conflict between her ideals and reality emerged, Captain Marcus appeared in Ana's world and helped her solve many problems.
In this environment, the two began to communicate. Before she knew it, this superior had become an irreplaceable friend to her.

comment.text: So it turns out Marcus was the one who led this little girl astray. I knew they were both stubborn as mules.

stories.title: An Objective
stories.text: Ana is very naive. She had never considered the hidden darkness behind this island, nor did she understand that her initial goal was just a fantasy. When she shared her ideals with Marcus, his genuine interest in her pure vision drew him in, and they spoke openly. As their dreams clashed and merged, Ana began to understand Marcus better. She trusted his judgment and believed in the righteousness of his path. Now, her only goal is to follow this leader she holds in such high regard.

stories.title: A Warrant
stories.text:
The 7th Mobile Squad became the victim of a conspiracy... Marcus, who had always strived to protect everyone, went M.I.A... and Rosa, known as the Valkyrie, was hunted down by friendly forces in White Maple... Ana didn't know why everything she believed in had fallen apart in just a few days. She was burdened with unfounded accusations and was like a trapped beast, thrashing around in her cage, unable to see any hope or goal, and simply venting her helplessness and confusion.
"Your fearless courage protected us and led us to victory," Marcus had said to Ana during a brief rest after a battle.
However, now she had no one left to protect.

comment.text: I know this feeling all too well. When we were being hunted by the NDF, I also lost my sense of direction for a while... but life goes on. You've gotta pull yourself together and keep moving forward.

profile.label: Title
profile.value: Chief Researcher of the Hyper-Aptamer project

10102108.introduction: Winston Gresham, neuro expert, pioneered medical Arashium. Pushed radical experiments in UNCS Hyper program, breaking Newman's limits. Crazy science, but Valentina says he's decent enough.

stories.title: Classified Record 1
stories.text: Winston Gresham is a world-renowned neurology expert and the leading figure in the intersection of "Arashium alloy" and neurology. He is also the director of the No. 3 Research Institute of the UNCS. Known for his meticulous work ethic, sharp insight, and exceptional execution, Winston was highly praised for his professional and interpersonal skills before being invited to participate in the "Hyper-Aptamer" project. His reputation, both in his field and beyond, is nothing short of stellar. Proud of his role as a scientific leader, he often takes part in public events, showcasing his unwavering commitment to advancing research.

stories.title: Classified Record 2
stories.text: At the invitation of UNCS Viceroy Blair Bluecher, Winston joined the Union-Obsidian Joint Research Institute as an expert researcher. Here, he met two other colleagues—Cicero, a rising star in the field of Arashium research, and Newman, who later became known as a "genius."

stories.title: Classified Record 3
stories.text: After joining the "Hyper-Aptamer" project, Winston's authority was challenged for the first time. Winston felt an insurmountable gap, whether it was Cicero's neural connection tech or Newman's Nova-Frame concept. Winston, who had never been willing to admit defeat, flung himself into a frenzy of extreme and reckless research, and the relationship between the three gradually shifted from mutual assistance and cooperation to competition, and even hostility. Everyone marveled at Dr. Newman's greatness when the Diaz sisters were found, and the Nova-Frame was completed. Winston finally realized who he was up against.

comment.text: Since then, Director Winston has become a different person. He became more focused on his research, even gradually becoming less receptive to the viceroy's suggestions and neglecting his personal needs, such as sleep and food.

stories.title: Classified Record 4
stories.text: Just as Winston had pushed himself to exhaustion, an unexpected turn of events disrupted the competition. Cicero and Newman, without Winston's knowledge or that of the entire UNCS Jurisdiction, led an escape plan... The result of the plan was the murder of Dr. Newman, and Cicero and Diaz's whereabouts became unknown. As the successor to their research, the viceroy ordered Winston to lead the follow-up work for the "Hyper-Aptamer" project. However, Winston no longer found joy in controlling the lab. On the contrary, his only desire was to surpass Newman. He would forge ahead with his own research, no matter the cost.

comment.text: Director Winston, the "Adaptor," has entered the final debugging phase. We will soon be able to officially deploy her onto the battlefield.

10102109.introduction: Northwest jungle merc, ex-gang boss. Bad blood with Movme. Luck made him Frida's man, and he claims he's Electric Eel's number two. Crafty showoff declared victory when GKD left his turf.

stories.title: The Greatest Mercenary
stories.text: Michael Moura, the greatest mercenary in the world—strategist, tactician, military leader, conductor, and ST pilot. I was once the leader of the strongest mercenary team in the Northwest Jungle. Due to my tremendous and selfless spirit, the "Electric Eel" has become renowned as the strongest mercenary group in existence. Therefore, the Electric Eel is of course incredibly grateful to me and has invited me to join them, already referring to me as their second-in-command.

comment.text: This entry was written by Michael Moura, also known as "Fenrir." Additionally, the term "conductor" refers to person in an orchestra responsible for conducting and is not a specific military title.

stories.title: Royal Descent
stories.text: Michael Moura grew up in a noble and wealthy family filled with love. His father was from the UNCS royal family, and his mother was a descendant of a DL political family. He could have become the ruler of one of the most significant countries in the world. Still, he was obsessed with the beauty and wonder of STs and empathized with the struggles of ordinary people. He followed his heart and gave up the right of inheritance to his UNCS royal fortune. And so, he came to Milkhama and became an ordinary mercenary.

comment.text: The UNCS is an alliance of federal states that has never had a royal family.

stories.title: The Island's Heartthrob
stories.text: After arriving at the Northwest Jungle, I brought order to the chaotic jungle and took over the local security management on behalf of the NDF. Through my firm and gentle leadership, I quickly became a beloved figure throughout West Milkhama. Even the UNCS Viceroy, Blair, expressed his considerable admiration for my efforts.

stories.title: Starting Afresh
stories.text: Later on, due to my assistance in resolving the security issues in the Northwest Jungle for the UNCS, Blair invited me to establish a special operations team for the Union. However, at that time, I had already retired. I politely declined, as I did not want to be involved in such mundane matters. However, the mercenary team's current leader, considering her team's future, secretly agreed to Blair's request. Out of respect for her, I decided to step forward once again to help the UNCS resolve issues related to the GKD Parcel Service.

10102110.introduction: Berguzar leads border refugees, descended from the first Milkhamans. Guides her people from West Milkhama's war. Proud, determined. Fighting to restore dignity to those who built Milkhama with sweat and blood.

stories.title: Milkhaman
stories.text: Although Bella grew up in a refugee camp on the border of West Milkhama, her father always told her to be proud of her heritage. He told her that, as a native of Milkhama, she was a rightful heir to the island—especially with the Milkhama Citizenship Certificate granted by the Joint Government four decades prior. Anyone holding that certificate, he said, was one of the island's true owners. Young and naïve, Bella didn't fully understand what it meant to be a "Milkhaman"—until the collapse of the mines, the destruction of the camp, and the countless workers displaced by the ravages of war. It was then that Bella finally saw the island's true face, and the sharp fangs hidden beneath its veneer of prosperity.

stories.title: Gold Panner Descendant
stories.text: Forty years ago, discovering the mysterious mineral "Arashi" brought countless gold seekers to Milkhama from around the world, all harboring dreams of getting rich. They ventured into every mine in Milkhama, mining the toxic raw α ore in hazardous environments. Two superpowers also successively introduced immigration policies, encouraging more and cheaper labor to participate in this grand gold rush. As α ore was continuously mined, many pharmaceutical and heavy industry enterprises became corporate giants, while interest groups from these superpowers reaped significant profits from the island. Meanwhile, the laborers who contributed greatly to Milkhama's development received little more than meager "Milkhama Citizen Certificates" as their only reward.

comment.text: Without these laborers, there would be no Milkhama today... However, both superpowers now consider the rebellion of Milkhama's citizens to be the cause of the war... Do they have no shame?

stories.title: Proof of Citizenship
stories.text: Bella's citizenship did not bring her the pride she deserved. On the contrary, countless struggling laborers on the edge of survival lost their homes entirely after the border war, becoming a source of turmoil and danger within the Milkhama jurisdiction. In an operation classified as a sweep, Bella's father was killed by the NDF, and all her hopes and dreams for a better future were shattered by the cold barrel of a gun. It was in that moment that Bella truly understood—the pride and freedom of the Milkhaman people must be earned through their own struggle, not given as charity or empty promises by others.

stories.title: Where to Now?
stories.text: The wandering of refugees continues to this day, but Bella has now found a sense of direction deep in her heart. Under Bella's leadership, the refugees have taken in more Milkhamans displaced by war and assembled their own STs from abandoned parts. Bella believes that no matter what difficulties they may face in the future, unity and self-respect will always be the most precious treasure and the most potent strength of the Milkhamans.

comment.text: They should consider joining The Ashes. Only when all oppressed people unite will Milkhama indeed welcome a real dawn.

10102111.introduction: Born to tinker. The master mechanic who dreamed of research. Life pushed him to repairs instead. Lost his spark, except when faced with cutting-edge tech.

stories.title: May 5, XC 95, Sunny
stories.text: "While these bipedal machines are impressive, they're far from the limit of Arashium alloy's potential. The possibilities are endless! For example, its magneto-rheological properties could revolutionize thermal energy conversion devices. Without a doubt, these properties can be extended to the aerospace field, enabling humanity to achieve feats never before possible! I'm determined to make these breakthroughs myself, which is why, after graduation, I plan to head to Milkhama to study and conduct research on the front lines!"

stories.title: January 14, XC 100, Snow
stories.text: "I don't care about labor uprisings or wars. Why should the NDF come and requisition our research institute and demand the assistance of our engineers in repairing their equipment? If they want to fight, they should do it themselves... and if they break something, they should fix it themselves! I didn't come to Milkhama for this crap!"

comment.text: He was trying to chase the soldiers out of the lab with a wrench, but got knocked flat instead... I get why he did it, I really do, but what could we even do to fight back?

stories.title: October 20, XC 115, Rain
stories.text: "Today, I unexpectedly found my diary from my younger years. It's been over a decade since I last wrote in it, and Milkhama and I have changed quite a bit. The research institute that I used to work at has started taking on new recruits, and STs have become commonplace. Arashium alloy has also begun to be used in other fields... However, as someone approaching forty and still working as a machinist to make a living, it no longer has anything to do with me."

stories.title: December 22, XC 117, Cloudy
stories.text: "Recently, my workload suddenly increased significantly, and I was asked to handle certain parts I'd never seen before. They were probably parts from a new machine brought in by the NDF. But how can that structure be applied to these machines? Is the entire frame made of Arashium alloy!? This is really something—no, it's none of my concern anymore! Yes, instead of thinking about this, I should just finish my work early and go home."

10102112.introduction: "The subject shows positive brain mod response. Tests cleared. No negative effects from memory/emotion wipes noted. Combat reliability meets baseline. Recommend live fire data collection." —Obsidian Internal Report

stories.title: Warfire
stories.text: Hawkwood was born into an ordinary family. His parents worked as frontline miners on Milkhama. They were not wealthy, but life was stable. That is, until one day, his father answered the call to join a labor protest and never came back. Not long after, the sudden outbreak of war claimed his last remaining family member. As a young child, Hawkwood wandered alone through the ruins of his home, where he crossed paths with a mercenary team sweeping through the battlefield.

stories.title: Mire
stories.text:
Still a teenager, Hawkwood had already become the captain of the mercenary team's Assault Squad. Like the other members, he lay in ambush on the side of a desert road, listening to the live broadcast of the ceasefire meeting on the radio, waiting for the target convoy to appear—ready to take on one last job before peace arrived.
However, this time, they had the wrong target... The security force escorting the transport convoy was the Obsidian Group.

stories.title: Experiment
stories.text: The researchers at Obsidian finally managed to calm Hawkwood down with a heavy dose of tranquilizers. Subsequent tests confirmed their suspicions—Hawkwood, whose extraordinary combat prowess had caught everyone's eye during the skirmish with the security unit, was perfectly compatible with their new technology. When he awoke from the complicated treatment, the only thing left in his mind was the name "Hawkwood," along with an unwavering loyalty to fight for Obsidian until the bitter end.

comment.text: Deleting emotions and memories has effectively improved combat stability. This achievement warrants further exploration...

stories.title: Change
stories.text: His operations were repeatedly hindered by the "GKD Squad," and working with Catherine and Lucia came with its own set of challenges... As a combat weapon, he was supposed to secure victory and prove the superiority of Obsidian technology. Yet, a series of setbacks had undermined him, eroding his confidence. It seemed to reignite an emotion he thought he'd long buried—anger.

profile.label: Title
profile.value: Obsidian Group's Outstanding Liaison Officer of the Year

10102113.introduction: "Want instant wealth? Status? Ultimate protection on killer Milkhama? Call ▇▇▇▇▇ for Lucia Voight's elite network! Obsidian Corp needs talent like you. Not interested? Keep my card. You will be." —Lucia's Merc Recruitment Card

stories.title: Campus Rumors
stories.text: "Haha, have you heard? That ass-kisser Lucia, you know, the one who loves to gossip... Haha, she's been expelled. I wonder where she's gonna end up now. I never liked her, that rumor-spreading, ugly skank! She always hid behind whoever had the most power... It's only fair that she's been thrown under the bus... Hahaha!" – White Maple High School BBS Message

comment.text: Hmph, someone who has been betrayed before... and is now willingly selling themselves out for Obsidian? You really haven't learned your lesson yet, have you?

stories.title: Code Word
stories.text: "A new contact person arrived here recently, and of course, they're from that big company. They always offer the highest price around here. Hmph, if you ask me, it's weird that such a big company sent a nervous wreck like her to a place like this... Don't get me wrong, she's pretty good in a fight and knows how to talk the talk, since being a broker's not exactly an easy job, but if I were her boss, I'd move her to a position with more potential. This border's just a damn mud pit—totally wastes a smart person's real skills..." — Mercenary Gossip

stories.title: CEO's Instructions
stories.text: "I heard the mercenary ops at the border have been running smoothly lately? Did you send someone new there? Yeah, I've heard of her. Supposedly young, tough to control, but seems to fit in well with the environment in Milkhama... Opportunistic and profit-driven, although none of those are exactly good traits, but right now, Obsidian needs people like that. If she makes a name for herself at the border, we can think about bringing her back to Milthus. I've got other jobs for her..." — Message from Raphael Gideon to his Secretary

comment.text: It's surprising that Gideon chose such a jumpy little brat as his confidante. He is no longer hiding his ambitions for the throne...

stories.title: The Art of Brokering
stories.text: "Have you met the new liaison officer? She's the unlucky seventh to rotate this quarter, but don't let that fool you. Smart, sharp, and quick on her feet—not your usual puppet who just repeats orders. Why give a damn about her? Simple. She's got potential. Like the rest of us, she's just another cog in the company's machine, but there's ambition behind those eyes... Heh, for now, Tolas can still sweeten the deal. But if Obsidian ever has an off day, I wouldn't be surprised if she's the one to push the company over the edge." — Catherine's Message to Hawkwood

10102114.introduction:
The Young Doll heiress came to Milkhama seeking thrills. Sharp eyes under that rebel act.
Blair's crew squeezed her family, so she's helping Arnold's faction and backing Kaidan's team.

stories.title: Little Miss No-Life
stories.text: Most people imagine Alyson Doll, daughter of the Doll Trading empire, leading a colorful and enviable life—endless money, servants at her command, beauty, impressive credentials, and a network of famous names all vying for a piece of the Doll Group. But for Alyson herself, there's nothing to celebrate except the constant buzz of boredom. She's seen it all, experienced every thrill the world has to offer, and now, the young heiress is craving something new—something she's never felt before.

stories.title: When a Bipedal ST Appears Before You...
stories.text:
When Alyson first saw the bipedal mechs in the border war, she immediately realized that what she had been pursuing for so long had finally appeared before her eyes. These STs, agile in action and equipped with heavy firepower, perfectly matched the young lady's love for novelty. However, when Alyson instructed her butler to purchase one of these vehicles, the latter showed a hesitant expression for the first time ever.
"My lady, if you really want to get your hands on one of these dangerous toys... we'll have to go to Milkhama."

comment.text: In recent years, civilian STs have become popular. They can be purchased in many places, not just in Milkhama... Might the young lady be purely interested in military models?

stories.title: Doll Family Territory
stories.text: Upon learning about the origin of the STs, Alyson immediately decided to move the Doll family's business to Milkhama. The Doll family, which had always focused on local dealings, suddenly ventured into Milkhama's business, attracting the attention of other corporate giants. They speculated about the Doll family's sudden move and wondered what their motives were. Little did they know that it was all due to Alyson's parents' indulgence and their spoiled daughter's whims.

comment.text: Don't buy into the lies! The Doll Group is only deliberately laying out their arms business for the future war! Their second quarter financial report clearly exposes this fact!

stories.title: Miss Doll Graces Milkhama
stories.text: The Doll family has established numerous industries in Milkhama, including fiercely competitive businesses such as mining and crude oil processing. After the Doll family's high-profile involvement in Milkhama, Alyson has built her own "amusement park" on the island and hired many mercenaries specializing in piloting STs to serve as her entourage as she roams Milkhama... The mercenary leaders in the Northwest Jungle are becoming increasingly frustrated with this spoiled heiress.

10102115.introduction: "Cicero Wright - trusts power more than science. Don't mistake him for a regular researcher. Showed his hand when he fled UNCS with test subjects to East Milkhama. Yeah, he's valuable to the League, but keep him away from real power. Meanwhile, extract and copy his tech fast." —DLAF Leadership Notes

stories.title: Research Begins
stories.text: "...Today, I met Viceroy Blair Bluecher at the NDF base. He is truly a bold man. However, his two companions... one a mediocre-looking doctor, and the other, Newman, seem to have some competence. But with just these two, it is impossible to advance the key project they call "Hyper-Aptamer"... Let me, the unparalleled genius of this generation, show them the potential of Arashium!" — Cicero's Research Notes

stories.title: Signs of Betrayal
stories.text: "Something unexpected happened today. Cicero figured out my escape plan... But what surprised me even more was that he had the same idea. Perhaps it's because of the "Hyper-Aptamer" project. However, Cicero is too concerned about his own safety and refuses to take Ada and escape. Instead, he headed to the DL Jurisdiction. This also fits Blair's evaluation of him—possessed of wisdom but too narrow-minded... But at least, if something happens to me, Ada has someone to rely on..." — Newman's Notes

comment.text: Cicero, Newman... You still need to awaken a thirst for progress, tying yourselves down with such small costs. I will use my passion... to accomplish what you cannot.

stories.title: Escape Direction
stories.text: "The main topic of this meeting is the asylum application of Cicero Wright, a key member of the UNCS research facility. I believe that our benefits of sheltering him after Dr. Cicero brought Diaz's valuable talent to the DL will far outweigh the potential risk of retaliation from the Union. Furthermore, considering the imminent bankruptcy of the NDF's "Hyper-Aptamer" project, now is the time for the DLAF to surpass the Union in terms of technology... and the young girl named Ada Diaz is also suitable for training as a valuable asset... to compete with the Union's Rosa Diaz." — DL Meeting Minutes

comment.text: Diaz... Is she the sister Rosa was trying to find and that Dr. Cicero took away?

stories.title: The Taste of Power
stories.text: "Newman... when we first met, did you ever imagine this situation would come about? You were the most promising newcomer among us, but now your stupidity is burying you in that desert. Your proudest work, Diaz, is also in my hands. Your achievements will serve as be the stepping stone for me to climb the ranks of the Dawnstar League... Ahahaha! I said it before when we first met—I said I wouldn't lose to you. No one should ever underestimate me, Cicero Wright!" — Recorded Communication Device Ramblings

10103101.introduction:
"Ex-merc. Bad record. Discipline issues. Teamwork uncertain. Great instincts, reads enemy patterns, can lead small ops.
Opinion: Train for mobile reserve, temp command ok. Note: Not for my squad. We don't take their kind."
—Rosa Diaz

stories.title: Where is Home?
stories.text: I wouldn't say I like to talk about my past as there's not really much to say... Just the story of some war orphan who grew up in a shelter, taken in by a kind scientist. But before my father's accident, I didn't really know who he was or what he was doing. He was always busy, practically living at the lab. He'd only show up at this place, "home," a few days a year. Sometimes I don't get it. If he didn't care about family, then why take me in? And why talk to me about all those far-out things I could never attain?

comment.text: As one reaches middle age, especially when you become aware of your own mortality, you suddenly start worrying about your legacy and children... Your father must have been moved by something similar when he decided to adopt you.

stories.title: Personal Bodyguard
stories.text: I was about fourteen when he first took me to their lab... well, calling it a "lab" is generous. It was more like a fancy ST repair shop. I'd already told him I snuck around and messed with some of the STs when he wasn't home... you know how boys can't get enough of that kind of stuff, but he was still all hyped up, going on about mech theories and all that tech stuff—he even let me hop into the cockpit. That was the first time I ever piloted a mech of any kind. When I climbed out, he looked at me and said, "Son, from now on, you'll be my personal bodyguard."

stories.title: Undetermined Fate
stories.text: So, I ended up being his personal bodyguard, tagging along with him to the research facility on Milkhama Island. Most of the time, I was out there piloting an ST, sitting through endless meetings with him. When he was too busy, he'd let me take on some side gigs for the security company—just as long as I didn't touch the STs at the lab. Then, out of nowhere, he disappeared for a while. No calls, no work, nothing. I didn't hear from him until my security firm got a hot job. By the time I got there, his ride was blown up by some unknown rocket fire, and suddenly, I'm the one they're pointing fingers at.

comment.text: We have checked the communication records of the security company Kaidan was with. It was found that the source of the emergency mission was the Viceroy's Office in the Milkhama UNCS Jurisdiction.

stories.title: The Truth of Innocence
stories.text: They said I did it, but they had no proof. After a bunch of questioning, they had to let me go. But not one of them bothered to tell me what really happened to my father, where he went, or what he was up to before he disappeared. All I got was cold stares, shady answers, and lies. I knew it was a setup. So, the day I got out, I stopped asking, stopped talking. I knew one thing—my future's mine to figure out, and I'm gonna find the truth myself.

10103102.introduction: Dana Yano - Enfield ace. Perfect grades, five-year sniper record holder. Eastern blood, cool head, sharp mind. Long-range specialist and a solid teammate.

stories.title: Heavy Burden
stories.text: I'm not sure when it started, but I've grown used to people expecting so much from me—Dana, you have to be number one, Dana, you need to stand out, Dana, there's no other choice... Dana, Dana, Dana... I try to live up to their expectations, becoming the "Dana" they want, the one who never lets them down, but I still don't know who the real Dana is supposed to be.

stories.title: Elusive Fairness
stories.text: When my request for a review of my grades was rejected, and I caught the frustrated gaze of Instructor Mary, I realized that there was never absolute fairness in the military academy. "Dana, face the reality. The cost of fairness is not something we can afford now," said my sniper instructor, who usually looked out for me. "Then what can I do to one day afford this so-called fairness?" I asked back. "You need to become stronger, even stronger than you are now. When you make a name for yourself in the NDF, fairness will naturally come your way," she replied.

comment.text: Dana Yano, now that's a name all military academy students knew back in the day! As for that Bluecher guy... what was his first name again?

stories.title: Rigorous Plan
stories.text: Joining the NDF is a crucial first step in my mercenary career. Iconic figures like William Stein and Rosa Diaz motivate me to build my own legacy. I have to stay sharp at all times. Kaidan Newman will be with me on this mission, and I expect his seriousness and attention to detail to meet my standards. I won't let anyone mess with my record.

comment.text: Serious and meticulous? Kaidan? Hahaha! How did this little girl manage to choose two exact opposites?!

stories.title: GKD Departure
stories.text: We've been in action for over half a year now as the "GKD Parcel Service." This kind of life is full of unknowns and dangers I never saw coming. Sometimes, in the quiet of the night, I recall the past, but before I can even lament my naivety and weakness, exhaustion knocks me down and I fall into a dreamless sleep. "Dana Yano, in the days to come, you must live like a cheetah, agile and free," I tell myself.

10103103.introduction: "I can't figure out how Grant got into Armored Corps! Sure, he's good with machines, but he's always boozing or heading to booze. Keeps modding our STs with weird parts... Can't trust my squad to this mess of a mechanic!"—Captain of the 11th Armored Corps

stories.title: Ideals and Reality
stories.text: I came to Milkhama Island for the war. I was young, all pumped up thinking I'd be out there piloting STs and feeling like a badass, so I signed up to join the NDF. But it turns out I was just putting down protests from pissed-off workers, nothing like the glory I saw on TV. I started getting sick of it, so I'd mess with my ST's wiring on the side to avoid being scheduled for missions. Of course, do that enough times and you'll get noticed. I got kicked out of the army real quick. So, to keep eating in this crazy world, I opened a repair shop, and let me tell you, fixing them beats piloting them in the military any day.

stories.title: Rainforest Machinist
stories.text: About two years after the war, I set up a repair shop in Burton Bay, deep in the Northwest Rainforest. From small watches to STs, I fixed it all, and word started to spread. I even started buying and selling ST parts, and business began to pick up. But Milkhama wasn't so peaceful back then—it was rough, worse than it is now. One time, I delivered a repaired ST to a client, only for them to refuse payment and surround me! It was a hell of a ride, but in the end, I took them all down!

comment.text: Grant, don't think I don't know you're bragging! There's no record on Skynet of this brawl you're talking about!

stories.title: Military Career
stories.text: Later, to handle the insurgents, the NDF expanded its forces, and I was specially recruited as a senior machinist for the Armored Corps Mobile Squad. From then on, I couldn't avoid William's constant tirades, and I racked up three—maybe four—disciplinary actions. Doesn't really matter. The point is, they never kicked me out. After all, the strain of keeping the new recruits and new STs in top shape wasn't something just anyone could manage. But the most advanced tech, the stuff hidden deep in the hangar, was always kept out of reach. I didn't think much of it at the time. Who knew that hidden behind all that gear was a chain of events that would lead to something far darker...

comment.text: It sounds like Grant was actually saved by his lazy attitude. It would have been difficult for him to extricate himself if he had been pulled into Blair's plan due to his excellent performance.

stories.title: Reborn from the Flames
stories.text: Who would've thought I'd end up back in the Northwest Rainforest after ditching the NDF? This time, they've got their eyes on me, but honestly, it's not as bad as it sounds. No weapons pointed at laborers, I can catch a nap when I want, and I've got all the time I need to tinker with my STs... These days with the GKD Squad have probably been the happiest of my life. You know, hanging around with Kaidan and Dana, I've started to feel some of that fire I had when I was younger. Doesn't matter how messy Milkhama's schemes get, as long as we stick together, we can handle anything that comes our way. But hey, don't go telling those two I said that, alright?

10103105.introduction: A woman of mystery, her identity is difficult to pin down. Operates on Skynet under the pseudonym "Accordion," but in truth she serves as an agent of the General Security Administration, working with her partner, Naomi. Both Obsidian and the NDF regard her caution.Her true motives are shrouded in secrecy, while her remarkable beauty and perfect figure bring men to their knees. Shrewd in speech, she carefully controls the flow of information, never allowing her interests to be compromised. A real femme fatale.

stories.title: Closing Performance
stories.text:
If it weren't for the sudden incident, Natalia might have lived a carefree life as a prominent noble. She would've only had to worry about whether her food tasted right, if the fire was warm enough, and whether her potential suitor measured up to her expectations—living the life of a noblewoman, from one privilege to the next.
However, on that day in XC 101, a group of Principality guards stormed the Ovett performance hall. Sir Coronado, sitting in the audience, left Natalia, who was playing the accordion on stage, to face the panic that swept through the crowd.

stories.title: [Espionage Offenses]
stories.text: When Principality authorities told Natalia she'd been arrested for "espionage offenses," she had no idea what the term even meant. It wasn't until then that the truth hit her—her father, so proud of his duchy bloodline, had been working for the UNCS all along. The family's fall from grace was swift—confiscations, arrests, her mother and brother locked away. Just a day before the arrest warrant for her was issued, an old colleague of her father's from the General Security Administration of the UNCS, Sir Coronado, showed up at her door.

comment.text: This person was supposed to be my immediate superior. Just a month before I joined the intelligence agency, he was suddenly killed at an Ovett base... *sigh* I guess being a spy really is a dangerous profession.

stories.title: Accordion
stories.text: With the help of her father's former colleagues, Natalia received the protection of the General Security Administration and escaped from the center of the vortex, the Ovett Principality. Determined to rescue her parents, Natalia, nicknamed "Accordion," became a special agent of the GSA. Armed with diligence and talent, she quickly became a key investigator, and through her relentless efforts, the truth about her father's past began to unravel.

In the year XC 113, Natalia found the name of her father, Sir Coronado, on a contact list intercepted from Obsidian. The secrets of Arashium alloy, Milkhama, the UNCS, and ▇▇▇▇▇▇▇ of Ovett Principality were revealed one by one before Natalia's eyes. After realizing she finally had a chance to rescue her imprisoned father, Natalia set her sights on that embattled island, cut off by boundless ocean.

comment.text: Strange... How exactly is this file encrypted? What's inside it?

profile.value: Don't expect to know more from here!

10103106.introduction:
Ex-Ether Rats ace hacker. Competitive rebel who cracked codes to expose truth. Got tangled in Obsidian/UNCS plots while running Skynet intel. Natalia helped her escape to GSA.
Don't let the punk student look fool you—she's a digital wizard no one dares ignore.

stories.title: Beginning
stories.text: Since my father's passing, my mother has done everything she can to keep me out of his study, as if it wasn't the gunfire but the research papers scattered across his desk that led to his death. One day, I couldn't resist—I picked the lock and rummaged through his things, searching for anything related to him, but all I found were piles of incomprehensible reports. As I was about to leave, something caught my eye—a black box buried beneath the mountain of books. It was just another terminal, nothing rare for researchers back then, but it changed everything. That device had the authority to connect to Skynet.

stories.title: Student Hacker
stories.text:
Maintaining the minimum attendance and achieving average grades, my campus life remained dull and uneventful even after entering high school. That was because I already knew that everything before my eyes was just the surface layer of this world. The truth—hidden deep beneath, in the sea of intelligence known as "Skynet"—was where I truly belonged.
But learning alone has its limits, and soon, a special security system stood in my way. "Can you break through our defenses?" This challenge letter suddenly appeared in my mailbox and brought me into contact with the "Ether Rats" hacker group.

comment.text: What? This girl's amazing hacking skills were actually self-taught?!

stories.title: Panic
stories.text: We're the top hacker group in all of Milkhama. Three years ago, I joined the Ether Rats, and since then, we've uncovered all sorts of truths through our hacks. I couldn't help but think, no matter our ages or backgrounds, we all shared the belief that if we kept pushing, we'd break down all information barriers and expose the truth to the world, bringing justice with it. But that very confidence is what led us straight into the trap set by the NDF and Obsidian.

comment.text: I remember the day a bounty for the Ether Rats suddenly appeared on Skynet, and then they disappeared without a trace... It's their own fault for being so stubborn and getting involved with Obsidian.

stories.title: The Path of Espionage
stories.text: The regulations of the General Security Administration are beyond anything I had imagined. I decided to use my position as an agent to get to the bottom of the NDF and Obsidian conspiracy, but instead, I found myself shackled by even more restrictions... Luckily, the GKD Squad's hijinks have shifted things a bit. Natalia granted me special operations clearance, allowing me to make contact and even provide direct support. No doubt, they've uncovered something crucial. If their goal is to expose the dark secrets hidden deep in Milkhama, helping them achieve that is exactly what I want... But as for whether that's what Natalia really wants, I'm not so sure anymore.

10103107.introduction: "Rosa Diaz, UNCS's Valkyrie ace! Beauty and skill made her a military idol. But beyond the promos and press? Pure mystery. What's her real story? More to come..." —Milkhama Entertainment Weekly

stories.title: Various Labels
stories.text: If there is one name that epitomizes the apex of ST mastery, it has to be "Rosa Diaz." As the highly lauded "Valkyrie" of the NDF, Rosa has become a living symbol for the organization. With an impeccable record, sharp skills, and a poised elegance, she's gained a loyal following both within the NDF and even among their enemies. However, no matter how many halos the outside world puts on Rosa, her response is always one of hostility and indifference... "I would rather not have been given such power from the beginning..." With that, she vanished, her secrets buried under the weight of public speculation.

stories.title: Fate Descends
