stories.text: Rosa knows all too well the cost of the praise she receives. She can control STs perfectly, being a Hyper-Aptamer who can directly resonate with Arashium alloy using her brainwaves. Still, this has also made her a natural-born test subject... However, the cruel cost of being a test subject is not entirely borne by Rosa but also by her sister, Ada Diaz, and the other girls brought in based on Diaz's blueprint... Needles, electrodes, prosthetics, and various experimental drugs... Rosa lay there in her glass cage, witnessing time and time again everything the UNCS did to those girls, knowing there was nothing she could do but climb into an ST and crush the coalition forces one enemy at a time, driven by that elusive promise.

comment.text: Not long after the Hyper-Aptamer project was proposed, Dr. Newman plotted to falsify data and terminate the project. However, with the discovery of the Diaz sisters, this attempt was ultimately thwarted under military pressure.

stories.title: Unending Nightmare
stories.text: "As long as the enemies of the NDF disappear from this island, both STs and pilots will lose their basic foundation, and Hyper-Aptamer research will naturally come to a halt." To uphold this unrealistic lie, Rosa became the Valkyrie. However, the stronger she became, the more necessary the research became. Behind the countless lines of incredible battle data was the deception and cruelty of the NDF, as well as the withering and despair of those girls... until her unexpected breakthrough—Cicero's escape, Dr. Newman's death, and the disappearance of her sister, finally caused Rosa to awaken.

stories.title: In the Face of Death
stories.text:
The enemies of the NDF are endless, and she is no exception. She could have been a savior to those girls, but in the end, she indirectly advanced the plan... Three days after Ada's disappearance, Rosa returned from the border. Blair used his authority to pardon her for her unauthorized action. However, Rosa will no longer be blinded by such "grace"...
Now, only those girls remain, and Rosa has made her decision—even if the final cost is death, she will redeem their shattered fate... Even if it means nothing more than a fleeting moment, like a blooming flower that fades in an instant.

comment.text: Rosa did nothing wrong. She was our savior, our hope... Even though she's passed away, every girl she saved will remember the way she bloomed in the end, just like the Epiphyllum.

10103109.introduction: "Catherine ignored me again, smashed the base... keeps pushing mods past limits. Not personality, pure crazy. Maybe that's what the lab rats want,  weaponized madness. Efficient use of resources?" —Lucia's Report

stories.title: Red and Black
stories.text: Catherine of Obsidian, captain of the Predators, is a twisted, complex, and enigmatic figure. In the eyes of most Predators and the Obsidian Group, she is a straightforward, reckless, but pure battle fanatic. However, in the eyes of her enemies, she is a terrifying monster who loves to play with her prey. Countless mysteries surround her, including her origins, her past, her strange and chaotic powers—but all the answers are carefully guarded by a high-ranking member of Obsidian.

comment.text: I know who's pulling the strings... I hope someone wakes up and realizes the situation before you completely ruin the legacy your ancestors left you... Don't say we didn't warn you.

stories.title: Yellowed White
stories.text: A quick look into Catherine's history reveals that this pilot, with no mercenary background, seemingly rose to become captain of the Predators overnight. In truth, the squad was formed as an experimental mercenary unit specifically for Catherine, with most of its members being unknown subjects of various experiments. According to unverified reports from Obsidian, Catherine herself intentionally erased all traces of her life as a "mere human" and only began her documented history from the point she underwent her physical modifications.

stories.title: Fresh Red
stories.text: After forming the Predators, Catherine voluntarily applied for multiple enhancement modifications. Catherine was the first participant in every Obsidian experiment. Perhaps due to the influence of the enhancement experiments, Catherine became increasingly obsessed with more extreme combat methods. The external manifestation of this change was the continuous occurrence of more reckless, crazier, and more brutal combat behavior, which also led to a constantly increasing casualty rate among her squad members and STs. The infamous name of the Predators quickly became synonymous with terror across all of Milkhama.

comment.text: Only a lunatic would tolerate being used for such enhancement experiments! Just look at the members of the Predators—Obsidian must have intentionally gathered them all together.

stories.title: Black Blade
stories.text: In the end, with the addition of Hawkwood and Gideon's confidante Lucia, the Predators achieved a delicate balance. The astute Lucia was responsible for coordinating the team members. At the same time, the ruthless Hawkwood executed precise tasks, and their leader Catherine, as the sharp edge of Obsidian, was responsible for clearing all obstacles standing before them. With Catherine's desire finally fulfilled, how will she now torment those remaining disobedient enemies?

10103110.introduction: Hong - Epiphyllum's eastern pilot, Sylvie's partner. Spinal injury led to Arashium experiments. Caught Winston's eye with sync rates. Rosa saved her. Now she and Sylvie chase ST and Hyper-Aptamer secrets.

stories.title: [The Nightmare Begins]
stories.text: You've probably noticed by now, I don't exactly blend in with the crowd around here... That's because I come from a faraway place in the East. Before landing on Milkhama Island, I lived with my sifu and a whole crew of senior sisters. Our daily grind was pure martial arts, perfecting our acting skills, and hustling on every stage in the city—sometimes as stand-ins for those big-shot movie stars. I shouldn't even be involved in the chaotic mess on this island, let alone get tangled up in any of this ST research crap... But thirteen years ago, everything flipped when I fell off a prop during a show and broke my back. That's when the real mess started.

stories.title: [The Mourning Continues]
stories.text: You know what a busted spine means, right? No feeling from the hips down, and a wheelchair for the rest of your life. I don't even remember what I was feeling back then—the whole world was like a blur to me. My sifu tried everything, but nothing worked. Just when we were about to throw in the towel, sifu got this invite from the UNCS Biomedical Research Organization. The doc on the other end said they were working on a spinal replacement tech, some kind of neural link deal, and if I went through the procedure, I might actually walk again.

comment.text: The UNCS once extensively recruited participants from around the world to partake in clinical trials for new medical technologies. Most cases ended in failure—Hong was one of the rare successes.

stories.title: [Luck of All Lucks]
stories.text: Following the information provided by the liaison, my sifu sent me to Milkhama Island... You can probably guess what happened next. The so-called neural connection technology was part of the "Hyper-Aptamer" project. After screening, I underwent targeted surgery and demonstrated high adaptability to the Nova-Frame in the experimental phase, becoming the lucky one among hundreds of subjects. Then, I was treated as a critical observation subject and locked up with Sylvie, Emily, and the others... I traded my future for my legs but I lost the freedom to walk with them forever.

comment.text: If neural interface tech had only been used for medical research, who knows what kind of breakthrough it could've been... It's too bad it ended up as just another terrible tool for waging war.

stories.title: [Farewell to Yesterday]
stories.text: After that came a long and challenging period of struggle with the aftermath, day after day—that was until Rosa saved us, but she fell at White Maple... We should leave the past behind and focus on living each day to the fullest. Rosa wouldn't want us, the people she rescued, to still be moping around like before... And one day, we'll uncover the truth and defeat the UNCS.

10103111.introduction:
"Canary, Senior Hunter, ST tech/support, Rebecca's partner.
Together they've crushed five 30+ ST gangs, cleared 20+ top bounties. Pack platoon-level punch. No direct contact, no custom jobs. 
Want them? Post triple rate - she'll bite. No guarantees." —The Hunter's Guide

stories.title: Resurrection
stories.text: "Send all the remaining Arashi inhibitors to Ward 41 immediately! First Lieutenant Hicks has specifically warned us that if this girl doesn't make it, our entire department's on the line, got it? Damn it! How the hell did she survive that explosion? If it weren't for the military's orders, no hospital would've even touched a patient like this... This is a mess..." — Outpatient Recording, XX/XX/XC 100

comment.text: I will never forget the tragic state of that girl. When she was taken to the hospital, we wondered who had placed a lump of coal on a precious hospital bed...

stories.title: Arashium Surges
stories.text: "Unfortunately, we can't create a detailed rehab plan for Melissa. The fact that she survived two years ago was nothing short of a miracle. Our current approach is administering the Arashi inhibitor and monitoring the data, hoping for another miracle. This method has proven effective, so we'll keep at it. And as per your instructions, Lieutenant, none of this data will be submitted to the UNCS Academy of Science and Engineering, including her claims of possessing a unique ST synchronization ability..." — Outpatient Note, March 31, XC 102

comment.text: It's such a pity... no, it's tragic that such a precious sample has remained hidden for decades.

stories.title: Regular Follow-up
stories.text: "Mr. Hicks, your decision to personally bring your daughter in for regular check-ups each month is a wise one. While traveling back and forth from the southern Parill Desert to White Maple is no easy task, the treatment is essential for her health, and requires our joint efforts... By the way, we've noticed there have been an increasing number of delayed payments from you in the past two years. This isn't exactly appropriate now, wouldn't you agree?" — Outpatient Recording, March 31, XC 115

stories.title: No News at All
stories.text: "Are you kidding me? Hicks is dead?! Send Melissa's file to Winston immediately, he's the new project leader... No, wait... Those files need to be destroyed, otherwise we'll have no way of explaining ourselves out of this to Blair and the others. The data we've been hiding for years is enough to put us on the list... Damn it, Hicks..." — Outpatient Recording, March 31, XC 118

comment.text: Only the living get caught in their own flaws. So, who really trapped who, me or Hicks?

10103112.introduction: "First time I saw Gumusiay—gentle face, deadly reputation. Didn't want her at first. But she's like us, tortured past, lost loved ones. It has a different style and the same fire inside. Strong as any of us." —Hong and Sylvie's Chat

stories.title: [Father]
stories.text: Every time I visit my father at the cemetery, my heart is constantly flooded with mixed emotions, and oh, how I wish none of this was true. He saved me, but he chose to turn his back on his duty for me—thank god I at least got to meet a genuinely kind person. I learned his real name after he died. He hid a lot from me, but in the end, he didn't take it all to the grave...

comment.text: The UNCS and Obsidian are attempting to research how STs can be manipulated through brain intervention...? That sounds awful!

stories.title: [Experiment]
stories.text: Every time I look in the mirror, I try to remember what my face looked like in the past, but I simply can't recall it. Even my memories of the past are vague. My father told me it was a result of that accident. Still, I feel like it's my own unwillingness to remember that blocks my recollections. How would I think of the present if I remembered my past life and my family? Would I hate them? Would I be angry? I don't know. My indifference has protected me and allowed me to support myself after my father's death... perhaps this is proof of successful treatment. All I feel now is the emptiness of irony.

comment.text: What was taken away was emotion... Although Gumusiay's experience wasn't exactly the same as ours, the pain we all endure is the same...

stories.title: [Child]
stories.text: I did care a lot about the orphans I adopted... Seeing their smiling faces made me feel like my father, and my tiny efforts to help them gave me a sense of redemption. With their help, I slowly recovered the emotions that were taken from me. I once wanted to protect them forever, but the reality of Milkhama taught me that no one can survive alone on this island...

comment.text: That's right! Don't hold back against our enemies anymore, Gumusiay!

stories.title: [Epiphyllum]
stories.text: Sylvie and I are in this together, though we still have our roles to figure out. This island gave us all the same scars. Sylvie wants everyone who's hurt and exploited us to pay. I'm not sure if that's what I want—I just hope there won't be more people who end up like us. Milkhama shaped Epiphyllum, and it's destined to be changed by it... It'll happen, one way or another.

10103113.introduction: Obsidian's youngest board member. ST ace and surveillance expert. They say she can open any door and see any message. Rumors say she's hunting the CEO for breaking company law.

stories.title: Inspector
stories.text: Obsidian was the first company to discover α matter and also the first to master Arashium technology. I am fortunate to have grown under the company's patronage, and have been entrusted with the position of supervisor. I will repay the board's trust with my loyalty and knowledge... And so, regarding those traitors who would steal the company's technological secrets and go off to create their own little empires, neither I nor the rest of the board will show them an ounce of mercy.

comment.text: This weirdo was the supervisor of Obsidian's board of directors? What kind of tricks did she have to pull to get into that hellish company's upper echelons?

stories.title: Eye of the Board
stories.text: I know there are rumors circulating within the company, some bored little flies questioning my abilities. They believe my position on the board is the result of some "special means"... I won't waste my time responding to their shallow, vile speculations, because I never waste time on idiotic fools. My focus must always be on those with more malicious intent. The enemies of the company are much more intelligent than these insects.

stories.title: From Gideon
stories.text: I've seen those insane test subjects. Well done, Mr. Gideon... I know he holds some inexplicable grievances against the board of directors and Chairman Obelisk, always thinking that if he controls more power, the company will bend to his will. To me, that shows nothing but ignorance of the board's meticulous strategy—pure childishness. The chairman would never want someone like that to be his successor, and Gideon can't rely on a bunch of lunatics to win inheritance... even if he is the founder's grandson.

comment.text: The two founders of Obsidian are Alexander Obelisk and Francis Gideon. The current CEO, Raphael Gideon, is Francis's grandson.

stories.title: The Real Mastermind
stories.text: Chairman Obelisk still wants me to go and deal with those fools causing trouble on Milkhama, even though I've informed the board that my departure will compromise information security within the company. However, due to the importance of headquarters' development plans and the overall situation on and off the island, I must prevent certain company members from colluding with the UNCS. I hope a certain self-proclaimed "manager" can understand his position. I will not be as merciful as Mr. Obelisk.

10103115.introduction: An NDF major and 20-year vet, fighting on the frontlines since the Milkhama Landing—a Blair loyalist, crushing rebels and lending his firepower to any operation that needs a rough edge. Past defeats left him with a heart of hatred and a savage style that terrifies allies and enemies alike.

stories.title: [Hero]
stories.text: William, who had just joined the army, instantly became a celebrity in the military. The reason for this is not his muscular, beast-like body or his excellent training data, but rather during a drill, he led the rookies in a charge against the officer's line, and ended up beating one of them to a pulp. Surprisingly, this heinous event was eventually settled, and both sides were punished. But every now and then, you'd catch a soldier grinning when the story came up—"That scumbag was always bullying rookies and stealing their stuff. William simply gave him what he had coming to him. He's a damn hero to us!"

comment.text: Passion, righteousness... This is a far cry from the William of today. What happened to him?

stories.title: [Warrior]
stories.text: As the captain of the UNCS's elite troops, William was selected to join the peacekeeping forces of the UNCS in assisting their cooperation with Obsidian, and landed with his unit on Milkhama Island to participate in the operation against the rebels. This was his first time piloting a fully armed ST in actual combat, and the results far exceeded expectations. Under the leadership of former frontline commander Blair, the troops he commanded repeatedly annihilated enemy forces. Even the DL's intervention couldn't halt their advance... But then, a sudden explosion in the Milthus region shattered their momentum, changing William, Blair, and the fate of Milkhama Island forever.

comment.text: The Milthus Explosion... I learned about it in history class. Was William actually a part of it?

stories.title: [Prisoner]
stories.text:
It has been nearly ten years since the ceasefire, and William has become a major in the Armored Corps. He still maintains high-intensity training difficult for most ordinary people to bear, regardless of his war-torn body and the fact that he is approaching retirement age. The war still imprisons him to some extent, and he cannot forget the unwillingness of his companions' sacrifice, nor can he forget his anger when ordered to retreat. He still has debts to settle with the culprit who caused all this.
The long wait finally led to a turning point—his former senior officer Blair approached him again and revealed to him a grand plan he had been brewing for years. William saw hope in it—a great hope worth any cost.

stories.title: [Devil]
stories.text:
The Ashes are rapidly rising, and the whereabouts of the traitors are unknown. The "GKD" that seeks to dig up insider information is becoming more active. The General Security Administration has also turned its attention to Milkhama. Even the Dawnstar League and Obsidian have increased their efforts to interfere. Blair and William's plan is facing unprecedented internal and external pressures.
However, this has made William's almost crazed belief even firmer. If he chooses a path of no return, he will drag the whole world into it.

10103117.introduction:
"Rebecca, Apex Hunter, raid specialist, Canary's partner.
Wild cowgirl pre-Canary, worked UNCS despite DL roots. She was a great solo fighter but dropped 70% of jobs following her whims.
Partnership cut bad reviews by 90%, seems Canary's got her in line." —The Hunter's Guide

stories.title: Getting Started
stories.text: "Miss Rebecca Klose, could you please confirm again that this ID card belongs to you? According to the current regulations, minors cannot apply for a bounty hunter license... No, no, I'm not suggesting that you become a bandit—I don't think children should... Look, you passed the test, and that proves you're qualified to become a bounty hunter. Please come back to collect your license three days from now." — Harpy Office Recording, July 24, XC 104

comment.text: I guarantee that nothing of that sort will happen in the Dawnstar League of today. The battlefield is no place for children.

stories.title: Cross-Border
stories.text: "Senior Bounty Hunter Klose, are you sure you want to transfer the collection range of this commission to the West Milkhama region? Although the war has been over for five years, as a citizen of the Dawnstar League and with extensive experience assisting military operations, your presence in the UNCS Jurisdiction remains... a sensitive subject. I'm sorry, I'll process the relevant procedures for you now, but please remember that your hometown will always welcome you back with open arms." — Harpy Office Recording, January 4, XC 106

comment.text: Taking on a job like hers, straddling the line of legality—it's a dangerous game. No one's gonna welcome someone crossing over from the other side of the island.

stories.title: Flexible
stories.text: "Rebecca! This is already the 18th time you've violated your contract... What did you say? You thought the employer was a jerk and didn't provide the information promised in the agreement, so you turned around and shot him? Remember, you need to complete a transaction if you want to make any money. You can't expect to succeed in this line of work if no one wants to hire you again!" — Harpy Office Recording, March 21, XC 110

comment.text: I'd kill for a crew full of characters like that. It'd certainly make things more interesting.

stories.title: Encounter
stories.text: "Welcome, Apex Bounty Hunter Rebecca, this mission takes you to the southern part of the Parill Desert. Tensions have risen between the autonomous military forces of the Doll Group and the UNCS in several nearby towns, and many civilians have requested help, hoping someone can offer them shelter... You want to know who the stationed officer is? Let me see... It's Hicks, the hero who made First Lieutenant during the Milkhama War..." — Harpy Office Recording, March 1, XC 117

10103118.introduction:
Rosa Díaz's younger sister, one of only two perfect Hyper-Aptamers in the world. Taken into the DL due to childhood events, she grew from a test subject of the latest technology into a super pilot carrying the hopes of the DL.
Bright and confident, elegant and courteous, she exudes a genius's aura yet always interacts with others on equal terms. When executing missions as a soldier, she often secures victory with her overwhelming personal strength, and if a teammate falls into panic, she readily comes to their aid. She is highly regarded not only in the Reversion Squad but throughout the entire DLAF. Even so, she always claims that this is not solely her own strength and resolve... What deeper meaning lies within, perhaps only she understands.

stories.title: XC 109, December 24
stories.text: "I had that dream again today, dreaming of a group of adults in white clothes breaking into my home and taking me away from my sister. I was so scared that I couldn't move, hoping someone would come to save me... At that moment, I heard my sister calling, but when I turned around, she was already lying on the ground, with that terrifying syringe stuck in her... I was awakened from my nightmare by the nurse. Behind her was a group of people in strange uniforms I'd never seen before. They huddled around the monitoring screen by my bed, seemingly discussing my abnormal brain waves. I wanted to tell them about my dream, that I wanted to see my sister, but not a single person paid attention.How long will these days last... My sister and I, the happy life we used to have together... are they really gone forever?"

stories.title: XC 111, February 7
stories.text:
"My sister came to see me today... She stood behind the stands of the ST testing ground, frowning through the glass, with an expression sitting somewhere between loathing and worry. I wanted to see her, to talk to her face to face, but the experiment didn't allow me to stop halfway. By the time I got off the ST, she was already gone... When I saw her again, she was covered in wounds from an emergency operation, receiving treatment in the medical room.
Wounds and injuries are hateful things, but the idea of losing my sister, the feeling of being powerless in that situation, it filled me with despair.
The entire time, I waited outside, pacing up and down. Eventually, Dr. Newman came out. I gathered my courage and told him my thoughts, then asked him when I could fight alongside my sister. He seemed stunned; I had never seen such a sad expression on his face. He patted my head—I could feel his hand trembling.
He looked around, crouched down close to my ear, and secretly told me something—he was preparing a special ST prototype challenge, and as long as everything went smoothly, my sister and I could leave and never have to face those annoying experiments and missions again. He just needed a little more time.
I feel like Dr. Newman is different from the other white coats; he really is kind... I trust him. Until that day comes, I will find a way to cope."

stories.title: XC 117, April 25
stories.text:
"This is the last page of the notebook. Quite some time has passed since the last entry. It's fitting to use a long-awaited diary entry to bid farewell to the past.
Looking back at all the previous pages, a lot of it shows my immaturity. Now I finally understand how fortunate I am compared to those poor test subjects. My sister, the doctor, Shawnee... If it weren't for everyone's protection, I might never have had the power to choose my own destiny.
It's incredible if you think about it. When I first accepted the experimental implantation, I was convinced I would be trapped in the Institute like a research specimen. But now, not only am I free, I've even been given the flattering title of "Super Pilot"—even the guys in the defense forces see me as a tough, iron-willed hero... When I think about all that happened, it's like a blur. Sometimes I wonder, which version of me is the real Ada Diaz, the one from then or the one now?
I think the source of the confusion is that most important, irreplaceable person... the UNCS's Valkyrie, Rosa Diaz, my sister, still trapped within the shadows.
Wait for me, sister. I'm far stronger than I was before. I promise, soon we'll be reunited."

stories.title: XC 119, March 9
stories.text:
"The GKD Squad took my sister. Though we've been enemies more than once, I don't believe they'll hurt her. If anyone can wake her, it's them... The real problem now is me. Since fighting in that space formed by arashi matter, the voice in my head has become increasingly vivid. "She" has started giving me warnings, about the Oceanic Conclave's tracking, about the hostility of former comrades... The way things are going, I will become an enemy of the DL. I'll no longer be that "Super Pilot"...
This is the reality I must face. But I will not regret my choices. I can't. I chose my sister over the DL, and I must stick to that choice until the very end... Otherwise, the suffering she endured, the sacrifices made by everyone in the Reversion Squad, it will all have been in vain. I must find a way to resolve things with "her," with A-00.
This is the end of the diary. If it falls into the hands of the Oversight Committee, everyone mentioned will be implicated. After filling the last page, the one that couldn't be filled last time, let it vanish into the flames along with all my hesitations."

comment.text: The subsequent search found the diary had been burned to a cinder, but the last page drifted into a crack in the ground not far away... A whim of the wind, or, perhaps... Ada, is there still a trace of hesitation in your heart?

10103119.introduction: In the days of the Hyper-Aptamer experiments, Sylvie and Rosa formed an unbreakable bond. She became the Valkyrie's most loyal shadow—and her hate for the labs spread across Milkhama runs bone-deep. With Rosa gone, Sylvie leads a crew of girls scarred by the same nightmares, driving them into a bloody revolt with no way back. She's got the mind of a leader and the will to match, but where her shaky fate goes from here... no one can say.

stories.title: February, XC 107, Sunny
stories.text: Today marks my second week here since being brought in, but Dad still hasn't come to pick me up like he promised... That white-haired girl appeared at the door of my room again. She told me that she and the people in white coats were not working together. She urged me to give up waiting and said she'd seen Dad discussing something with those grown-ups... I don't believe he could've brought me here... Why would he do that? After Mom left, Dad didn't smile again... I wish Mom were still here...

comment.text: Sylvie... was actually sent by her father to this UNCS research facility!? That guy... There are no words to describe how despicable he is, willing to sacrifice his own daughter for the sake of his so-called research.

stories.title: April, XC 108, Cloudy
stories.text: This is my third diary since they confiscated the others from me... Thank god for Rosa. She used her access to grab it from the warden's quarters. Yep, Rosa's the only friend I've got now. Sure, she's a bit rough sometimes, and her situation's different from ours, but she's honestly pretty badass. She's even planning an escape for us, though... can we really pull it off? I'm not sure. But if she's in charge, I think we've got a shot!

comment.text: Is this a diary? Is this page about her and Rosa's past...? Wait, do I really want to risk getting beaten up and keep reading it?

stories.title: April, XC 113, Overcast
stories.text: In today's "training," the current was way stronger than usual. I lost track of how many times I blacked out. Rosa came to visit me, like she always does... She says it's punishment for all our failed escape attempts... I don't get it! Why do we have to go through this? I screamed and tore at my uniform until Rosa held me tight... She keeps telling me that one day we'll get out, just like she did with her "sister"... But I'm too sick and tired to believe in any of it anymore. My father betrayed me... Will Rosa do the same?

stories.title: July, XC 116, Rain
stories.text: I escaped, but Rosa didn't. ▇▇▇▇▇▇, the only thing that keeps me going is knowing that Hong and Emily are doing well. We were all saved by Rosa, but then the UNCS took her away. I can't let that slide. Even if they took her physical body, they can't stop us from continuing to fight for her beliefs... The pain this island has given us, we will return it tenfold in Rosa's name... ▇▇▇▇▇▇, in the name of the Epiphyllum.

10103120.introduction: Young mechanic chasing Milkhama dreams. Prefers mods to repairs and is fascinated by Arashium. Runs Lollipop Machine Shop with one rule: top service means she mods your ST her way.

stories.title: Wrench
stories.text: Ever since I was little, I just loved hanging around my dad. He was always tinkering with all kinds of machines, stuff that most people would never find interesting. But somehow, he could make it all come to life. I remember one time, I couldn't resist anymore and decided to try fixing a clock and a microwave at home just like he did. Except, I had no idea how to put them back together. So, there I was, surrounded by pieces, and Mom was about to lose it. But Dad, with his big grin, just grabbed his wrench and took care of it like it was nothing. That's when I found out he used to be a machinist on Milkhama Island.

stories.title: Gummies
stories.text: Whenever I asked my dad about his days as a machinist on Milkhama, he'd just shake his head, that tired, knowing look in his eyes, before telling me not to waste my time thinking about that place. "The world's best, most cutting-edge STs are manufactured and invented there, but it's also where the most brutal, most horrifying ST battles take place." I remember his serious expression as he spoke, "It's a paradise for machinists, but a hell for ordinary people."

comment.text: Since the technological innovation of Arashium, Milkhama has become the preferred location for ST manufacturing and ST technology research due to its proximity to raw material sources. Calling this place a machinists' paradise is no exaggeration.

stories.title: Bolt
stories.text: I still can't figure out what makes Milkhama so special—why my dad both fears it and can't seem to stay away. But ever since then, it's felt like my fate's been tied to that damn island. Before long, I was shadowing him at the shop, running errands, learning the ropes. By sixteen, I had my own machinist's license. When I told him I wanted to head to Milkhama to see the latest STs for myself, he didn't say a word. But the next morning, I found an old bolt from Milkhama, the kind he'd brought back years ago, slipped in with my stuff. No words, just that bolt. I guess he knew I'd made up my mind to go.

comment.text: Tsk, that girl keeps that bolt right on the counter in her shop... Doesn't she know how tough it is to get your hands on something made of Arashium alloy? What the hell was her old man even doing back then?!

stories.title: Lollipop
stories.text: Dad wasn't wrong—Milkhama Island really is a paradise for machinists. With the money I earned from doing side gigs, I saved up enough to open my own repair shop on this island! I'm seriously pumped to check out this new material they call "Arashium." I swear, once I get my hands on it, I'll make some insane upgrades! And now that I've got a new direction to expand my business, my shop's gonna be one-of-a-kind. Dad always said a good name is half the battle, so... I'm calling it the Lollipop Machine Shop!

10103121.introduction: "It's all true, every word! I watched Davies leap from her ST, tear my cockpit open barehanded, and yank me clear! Then, hostiles showed up in STs while we were on foot. I thought I was dead until Davies roared, charged them, grabbed an ST in each hand, and crushed them together..." —DLAF Defense Corps Show Transcript

stories.title: Weightlifting Champion
stories.text: When the Milkhama War broke out, Diracca Davies, the DL weightlifting champion, was on a flight to Milkhama for the world championship in Milthus. But when the plane made an emergency landing in East Milkhama and the sky ahead erupted in flames, Diracca sensed that her fate had just taken a turn—one that would change everything.

comment.text: Diracca Davies! The Lightweight World Champion of the 72nd Weightlifting Championships! I remember buying her signed poster when I was still in boot camp!

stories.title: Militia Captain
stories.text: Due to the sudden outbreak of war, all Milkhama came to a standstill, and chaos ensued. Daily life fell into disorder, and everyone scrambled to escape the island. Diracca, once a renowned athlete with a glamorous reputation, found herself powerless. Like so many others stuck in the war zone, she was forced into a cramped, damp air-raid shelter, enduring each day with an uncertain fear of the future. On the seventh day, a military officer from the Dawnstar League entered the shelter and announced the government's call for recruits to form a militia unit.

stories.title: New DLAF Star
stories.text: From then on, Diracca's destiny took a turn. She joined the DLAF militia as a conscripted soldier. She was soon recruited into the regular forces due to her outstanding physical abilities and exceptional combat potential as an ST pilot. Diracca, a former athlete, was promoted to Squad Captain for her excellent leadership skills in the border war. Later, in the operation against the NDF's mobile units, she successfully captured an experimental ST, bringing back a valuable prototype sample for the DLAF

comment.text: The DL and the UNCS belong to two entirely different schools when it comes to applying Arashium alloy. Since the DL has already obtained a prototype, why has the feasibility of sensor research yet to be considered?

stories.title: Legendary Warrior
stories.text: After the war, Diracca was promoted to DLAF Lieutenant and continued to serve as a military officer of the Defense Forces in the East Milkhama region, stationed at the border. Whenever she recalls receiving her opportunity to join the DLAF, she marvels at the wonders of fate. Of course, even though Diracca is no longer a weightlifter, she hasn't given up on the sport she once loved so deeply. They say she occasionally holds weightlifting competitions at camp. Unfortunately, the worthy opponent she has been looking forward to competing with has yet to appear.

10103122.introduction: "Boss Frida's a damn legend here on Milkhama! I've been running with her since five, six years back, right when we changed name to Electric Eel. She cleaned house alright, got us all in line. People say Milkhama's a land of opportunity—don't get played! It's full of peril. But thanks to Boss Frida guiding us and all that, we're still here, still standing strong! We owe her, big time." — Garm, Electric Eel

stories.title: Intertwined
stories.text: For Frida, Milkhama Island holds a special place in her heart. She loves it for its year-round warmth, a far cry from the freezing winters the northerners always complain about. But she hates it, too. She hates how those without money are left with nowhere to turn; how the powerless are pushed to do whatever it takes to survive. Get stronger, make money, stay alive—that's the only thing that drives Frida as she fights her way through the mercenary ranks.

comment.text: Frida García was expelled from the orphanage at the age of thirteen for fighting. Since then, I've heard her name pop up now and then among the police.

stories.title: Survival Instincts
stories.text: Shaped by over a decade of ruthless experience, surviving in the mercenary world taught Frida the hard truth: if you're weaker, surrender and bide your time for an opportunity to strike back. If you're stronger, apply maximum pressure and drain every last bit of usefulness from your opponent. Armed with this brutal survival instinct, Frida thrived in a male-dominated mercenary group, earning the respect of the old leader, John Warren. By the time she was twenty, she was second-in-command. Though the old leader treated her well, living under someone else's command would never satisfy Frida.

stories.title: Mercenary Queen
stories.text: Frida finally got her chance. The unexpected death of her veteran leader triggered a power struggle among the mercenaries. She piloted her ST and led her followers through the cockpit of every rival and rebel, ultimately becoming the new leader of their motley crew and renaming it "Electric Eel."

comment.text: Even though John Warren's death by gas poisoning at his long-abandoned home was officially ruled a suicide, I can't rule out the possibility of foul play.

stories.title: The Path of the Electric Eel
stories.text: Power represents both absolute strength and an inescapable responsibility, and the crown of leadership was far heavier than Frida had imagined. Faced with an imminent financial crisis, Frida inadvertently found herself involved with the NDF, becoming a long-term partner of Blair Bluecher. Since then, the Electric Eel has experienced unprecedented growth and expansion.

comment.text: Recruitment ads for the Electric Eel are plastered all over almost every bar in town! I don't know about taking orders from some woman, but you can't argue with that salary....

10103123.introduction: Goman leads the Ashes—a ghost on Milkhama. Some say UNCS, some say DLAF, and some whisper Ovett. His moves and motives are shadows, but his people trust him blindly.

stories.title: January 20, XC 101, Heavy Snow
stories.text: "Tomorrow is my day of departure. In the afternoon, I drove alone to the suburban cemetery. The cemetery was empty and blanketed in heavy snow. I strolled to that familiar location, bent down to brush off the snow on the gravestone, placed a bouquet of chamomile, and then stood up, bowing my head to gaze at the bouquet and the name buried under the swirling snowflakes. This may be the last time I visit them. I closed my eyes and listened to the long string of names exploding in my heart like sparks in a fireplace."

stories.title: November 24, XC 104, Cloudy
stories.text: "Today, Dr. Newman invited me to have tea with him. During our chat, he showed me pictures of the foster son he keeps in the hidden compartment of his wallet. His face was beaming with a happiness that I had never seen before. It was surprising to see that this scientist, who usually appears so serious and studious, also has a warm and personable side."

comment.text: My father hardly ever mentioned his friends in the NDF to me. How many more secrets does he have that I don't know about...?

stories.title: March 28, XC 112, Showers
stories.text: Two hours ago, a warrior named Ronnie asked me about the meaning of "The Ashes." Before I could even answer, he was gone, his grip still tight on my hand as they wheeled his lifeless body away. Truth is, I'd long since forgotten where I'd first seen this powerful name—perhaps it was in some poem honoring the fallen. Create faith, destroy faith; build trust, trample trust... Maybe it's fate's mercy that Ronnie never witnessed either of them crumble.

comment.text: Huh? Faith? Trust? What is this guy trying to say...?

stories.title: January 17, XC 117, Cloudy
stories.text: Newman's adopted son is more resilient than I imagined. Although I never doubted that he could survive the pursuit of the NDF, I was still surprised when I received a message from the Northwest Jungle that day. He and his team will eventually turn this island upside down. It has been sixteen years... many things are overdue for resolution.

10103124.introduction: "Heard Marcus got called up again, by Major William this time! Kid's solid in a fight and reliable, too. Just won't back down. The same attitude that got him in trouble at the academy. Keep that up in the NDF? Matter of time before it bites him." —Ex-UNCS Grunt

stories.title: April 8, XC 111, Cloudy
stories.text: "Though the war has been over for a decade, spring in Milkhama still feels as grim as it did in my childhood. Today, a small-scale conflict broke out in the welfare home. Sandy insulted Alexander's parents, who died in the war as executioners, so Alexander punched Sandy's nose crooked. They fought until they were pulled apart, covered in blood. The overt war has ended, but its aftermath has not entirely disappeared..."

comment.text: The orphanage... If my father hadn't adopted me, I'd probably have grown up there...

stories.title: July 14, XC 112, Cloudy
stories.text: Today marks my first anniversary of serving at the UNCS Desert Base, and it's rest day to boot! The same batch of recruits who came in with me blindfolded me first thing in the morning, dragging me somewhere I had no clue about. I asked at least seven or eight times where the hell we were going, but not a single one of them answered. After about half an hour, they finally told me to stop, and before I knew it, someone kicked me in the back. I barely had time to curse before I went flying face-first into some chillingly refreshing water! So this is what they were up to—those sneaky punks brought me out here to swim...

stories.title: October 27, XC 112, Rain
stories.text: "Every time I sit in the cockpit, I feel a sense of emptiness. The connection between the cavalry, Milkhama, and peace has become increasingly blurred in recent years. Was my choice the right one? Is the path I'm taking leading to true peace? What is the truth...?"

stories.title: January 1, XC 113, Sunny
stories.text: "Ah, another year has come and gone! I suddenly realized I hadn't written in my diary for almost half a year. Time really flies... So much happened over the past year—some cried, some laughed, some sacrificed, and some were truly remarkable. The truth, still hidden, has slowly started to surface, and peace feels farther away than ever. But one thing's for sure—I'll keep fighting for what I believe in..."

profile.label: Published Works
profile.value: Warzone Travel Guide: Battlefields to Beauty Spots

10103126.introduction: "During a journey, I was commissioned to help some villagers get rid of some nearby bandits. As I left, I advised them on what to do if we encountered the enemy: push them back with perseverance and fighting spirit, just like the laborers in the Milkhaman War—it's the only way the weak can overcome the strong. They promised me they'd follow my advice. But when I returned a few days later, all that remained of the village was scorched earth. The few survivors told me that when the bandits came back, the villagers had not fought, instead hoping to make a deal. Clearly, this approach did not quell the bandits' bloodlust, and the villagers paid a heavy price for their naivety. What did I learn from this incident? Simply this: half-hearted resistance is not resistance at all. It brings neither understanding nor concessions, only death." —Warzone Travel Guide: Battlefields to Beauty Spots"

stories.title: Vast World
stories.text:
With the signing of an agreement, the war finally came to an end. 
The future might still be uncertain, but for now, most people have seen their hopes realized. Those who had been displaced or victimized were, for the first time, granted a nominally-autonomous region—a home, place where families can grow, the environment can be restored, and commerce can resume. Life remains difficult, yet they pour their energy into reconstruction, creating a place they can call their own. By turning their tears into sweat, they can recover, and they know this better than anyone. 
Still, there are some who cannot settle into this new chapter. It's not that they oppose the new peace, but even without the need to defend their freedom with weapons, the fire in their heart burns strong. Thus these warrior spirits left the island, their home, and headed out into the wider world to seek a new cause. 

Before the eyes of the gathered crowd, a fierce, passionate, brown-haired girl stepped aboard the ship. As the ship departed, she turned, waved to her comrades, and promised that, one day, she would return.

comment.text: Cassha said her temper in the past was as short as mine... It's hard to imagine...

stories.title: Footprints
stories.text:
"Mysterious Woman Foils Robbery at Local Market: Witnesses Describe Her Amazing Skills"
"Tourist Turns Angel: Female Tourist Rescues Orphans in Flood, Leaves Behind a Muddy Teddy Bear"
"Warrior from the South? Non-Local Joins Local Resistance"
"Chaotic Outsider: Foreign Woman Entangled in Political Turmoil, Officials Call Her 'Uninvited'"
"Nighttime Shadow Hero: She Appears and Disappears, Leaving Only Clues to Solving Problems"
............
It had been a wonderful journey, and Cassha didn't want it to end. One night on her travels, she leaned against her ST, gazing out over the drifting smoke. Foreign faces sang and danced in celebration of freedom and rebirth, while beneath them lay countless unmarked graves... Time and again along the road, she relived that war of years past, bringing victory to the oppressed in one fierce encounter after another. Yet for some reason, the more she saw, the more that island revisited her dreams. Along with the growing pull to return home came an unease, a feeling that kept her awake at night. She made up her mind. She would go back. And that unease... would soon become a reality.

comment.text: "I will not fail, simply because I am justice, and justice... is the side that never fails!" I heard she once said this line in a report... How should I put this...? It's kinda embarrassing, even for me.

stories.title: Stranger
stories.text: "Is this New District One?" In Sankara's diplomatic reception hall, a brown-haired woman posed the question. Her demeanor was composed and steady, not at all like a Milkhaman, yet her turns of phrase carried a distinct local flavor. After several rounds of confirmation and searches, the receptionist finally unearthed the origin of this "New District One" buried in a thick pile of documents. It was the old name of Sankara, a mining town built for laborers—a name forgotten to most.Like the town itself, the woman spent several days moving through Sankara, searching for those who had once waved her farewell. Time had altered everything. Those who once starved had built homes of their own, only for those homes to be reduced to rubble when new conflicts erupted. Settlements were built upon the ruins of old settlements, only to be reduced to ruins themselves.Yet the cycle continued. Is "victory" merely an illusion? Was this "change"?Feeling the rumbling of the forces returning to the border, a faint answer was already stirring in her heart.

stories.title: Far from Done
stories.text: "It was a reconciliation worth remembering, a marvel in its own right.. It felt as though fate had drawn them together... Of course, beyond them, many compatriots could not grasp our decisions, could not fathom the burdens we carried. Yet that was irrelevant. So long as someone stands, so long as someone is willing to lay down their life for all, hope persists. Our future may be broken, our blood may stain this land... But if we can grant even a fleeting moment of peace to others, if the world beyond can hear the faintest echo of our voice, then we have succeeded. We will be the last sacrifices on this land, the final stars before the dawn of a new day... Cassha Lumiere said so." —Vesper Soldier Memory
