10103127.introduction: "Where did we leave off last time? That's right, for battle plans, ask Cassha; for ST maintenance, go to Lorenzo. If you need fine-tuning like weapon modifications, you should find Arthur. Her workshop is at the third entrance down the base corridor—hold on! Don't rush off just yet, there are a few things to keep in mind before you go. First, never use Arthur's name lightly, not even as a joke... unless you want to get hit. Second, when writing your order, be concise and straightforward about what you need, don't beat around the bush... or she'll get angry. Lastly, if you hear complaints, keep smiling and stay silent... otherwise you'll just hear even more. Haha, don't be nervous, despite all the rules, the girl isn't bad. As long as Arthur has promised something, she'll go all out to make it happen. To meet everyone's bizarre modification requests, Arthur's workshop often stays lit deep into the night... Last of all, you should mingle with the others, get to know them. Oh and, again, seriously: don't joke about Arthur's name!" —A Vesper Warrior's Chat Log

stories.title: Shadows of Childhood
stories.text:
Long before Arthur could remember, her parents had fallen in the border war. By the statutes of the relief act, Arthur—recognized as a war orphan—was to be placed in an orphanage established by a subsidiary of the DL, where she would receive a complete education and meticulous care until the day she grew into a "sound and capable citizen" of the League. But reality, as always, fell far short of the promises made by the authorities.
"Honestly, what kind of girl goes around with a name like ‘Arthur'? Such a tomboy!"—"Oh no, the tomboy's angry! Quick, run, run!"—"Arthur, why are you whining about changing your name again? Can't you just behave? This was your parents' last gift to you, their final wish—don't you dare betray it!"
Mockery. Bullying. Indifference. These were the patterns that defined Arthur's life within the orphanage. Her only comfort lay in the small stack of books left behind by her parents. Whenever the cruel children came to torment her, she would run to her room, barricade the door, and lose herself in the dense, difficult pages. After all... books never laughed at her.

comment.text: "A General Discussion on Mech Soldier Artillery Craftsmanship," "A Brief Introduction to Mech Soldier Device Applications"... The things Arthur's parents left for this child were truly, er, substantial.

stories.title: Journey
stories.text:
Arthur remembered it clearly; the day was stiflingly hot. The STs, once confined to the outskirts, began appearing more and more frequently within the city. The rigid welfare director had grown increasingly eccentric, constantly muttering words like "Vesper" and "terrorists." It was on that very day that Arthur encountered the so-called "Vesper"—an wounded warrior slumped against the wall, refusing to let the flames of war spill into this place. Though the patrolling soldiers were only streets away, she did not step into the orphanage. Before the DL pursuers arrived, Arthur had already pulled the warrior inside. She knew which alleys wound through the cluttered buildings, and which walls hid a passage no one else noticed. The only difference was, this time, she would not be running from those kids... she'd be running from fully-armed soldiers. When they finally got out of the city, the warrior asked her what she wanted. Arthur lowered her head. "I just want... to leave this place." 
It wasn't until much later that Arthur understood—the person she had helped that day was no ordinary soldier. It was none other than the top figure of "Vesper"—Cassha Lumiere.

stories.title: Problem Child
stories.text: Life for Arthur in Vesper was far from smooth sailing. Growing up in an orphanage, she spent every day outsmarting and outmaneuvering the troublemakers. Even after changing environments, Arthur had no idea how to interact with people. Mentioning names led to arguments, bringing up issues made her anxious, and when she lost her temper, the entire base could hear her. It took less than a week for Arthur to become the infamous "Problem Child" of Vesper. In truth, Arthur wasn't blind to these issues— she genuinely wanted to change. She once tried to imitate Cassha, answering rudeness with a gentle smile. But her awkward grin only made them laugh harder—followed by a heavier punch... Another time, Arthur made efforts to listen when others talked about her, like Lozolen But the others simply assumed she wasn't angry and kept on talking until Arthur was about to explode. Faced with these frustrations, Arthur turned to Cassha. Cassha patted her on the head and told her simply, "You don't have to be us. You have to learn to be yourself."

stories.title: "Nadib"
stories.text: To pinpoint when Arthur was officially listed as a target by the DL, we must retrace our steps back to the "Fog Zone Assault." In that battle, the DL specifically chose the fog-shrouded zone as the site for their defensive line, intending to use the thick mist to block Vesper's offensive until reinforcements could arrive. Unexpectedly, a Vesper warrior named Arthur Nadib charged headlong into the fog. Braving the DL's gunport fire, she lit her guiding beacon, and under her guidance, the assault team broke through the DLAF's final defense like a hot knife through butter. It was only afterward when the DL reviewed the combat reports tied to Arthur that they realized how troublesome this fighter truly was—close-range gunport capable of blasting through armor, missiles destructive enough to wreck entire launch systems, reactive armor that could practically double as demolition charges... Arthur's inventions and modifications were cut from the same mold as the girl herself: unreasonable, obstinate, tenacious. Once she sank her teeth into a target, she would never let go.

comment.text: Although its stability and safety are appalling, the child's inventions possess a quality that the standard weapons of the Defense Force Research Institute lack—originality.

10103130.introduction:
**OFFICIAL NOTICE OF DISCIPLINARY ACTION**
**From: The Office of the Registrar, Garland Military Academy  
**To: [Dean Knight]   
**Date: [XC -----]  
**Subject: Notice of Disciplinary Action
**Dear [Dean Knight],
This letter serves both as an acknowledgment of your recent actions during the simulated combat exercise and the consequent disciplinary measures.
We've noted your involvement in an unauthorized operation that you described as a "direct strike on the enemy's command center." While your tactical skill is admirable, this action resulted in a major breach of discipline and protocol, significantly disrupting the Academy's exercise both in structure and spirit.
The Garland Military Academy values the unique talents of its cadets, including your innovative spirit and leadership skills, which, when directed correctly, will benefit both the academy and the wider defense community.
It's crucial to remember that obedience, respect for hierarchy, and protocol adherence are also key qualities for an officer. Balancing innovation with compliance is vital.
Considering the above observations and your notable contributions to the Academy, especially your culinary achievements highlighted by your wins in the Campus Big Eater Challenge, a disciplinary action designed to encourage productive reflection has been decided:
**Effective immediately, you are assigned to oversee the sanitary maintenance of the school's cafeteria for a period of three months. This assignment not only leans into an environment you find enjoyable but also serves as a potent reminder of the importance of order, discipline, and service.
May this period of reflection enhance your commendable talents with the wisdom to navigate the demands and responsibilities of leadership.
**Sincerely,
[---- -----]  
Registrar  
Garland Military Academy

stories.title: New Generation
stories.text:
In the eyes of the DL, XC 101 on Milkhama Island was their era.
The UNCS surrendered its advantage and stolen land, signing a peace treaty and retreating to West Milkhama. For once, the island knew peace, with the Dawnstar League symbolizing hope over East Milkhama.
The achievements of the DLAF were widely recognized in East Milkhama through various channels, including television and schools, emphasizing the importance of truth over falsehood. The critical takeaway for East Milkhama from the war was the eventual victory of justice over aggression, symbolizing the enduring resilience of the DL.
Regarding problem-solving, war is not an unacceptable option, and people believe this.
"I, Dean Knight, now swear that no matter what happens, I will be loyal to the Dawnstar League and its people, and serve to uphold justice!" Years later, at only thirteen, Dean uttered this pledge during his interview at Garland Military Academy and has remained true to his word ever since.

stories.title: Cafeteria Legend
stories.text:
The Garland Military Academy's cafeteria is buzzing with the legend of an undefeated champion. Since his arrival, he has dominated eating competitions, leaving food vendors astonished. Even the most challenging fast food contests have been abandoned due to his unmatched appetite. With each new feat, his legend grows, sparking intrigue and amazement. Will this be the beginning of a new era in competitive eating?
Luckily, the legend lives on, and we're delighted to welcome the cafeteria's shining star—Dean Knight! Please share with the audience what food means to you.
"Of course, eating is the most important thing there is! No food, no energy—you're gonna have a bad time! That's why every meal's a battle. You show up hungry, and you show up ready to win!" — DL Food Channel

comment.text: News about big eaters is always full of hyperbole, but if they're talking about Dean... I guess it doesn't seem too far off.

stories.title: Jadeite
stories.text:
"When evaluating Dean's performance, we couldn't help but feel a complex mix of emotions. His battle intuition and strategic deployment abilities have brought unexpected victories in multiple actions, and his unique insights and innovative thinking in terms of battlefield strategy are admirable. However, his behavioral patterns often cause concern, especially his preference for high-risk strategy, which, although creative, inevitably puts individuals and squads in potential danger. This trait demonstrates both his bravery and confidence, as well as a certain lack of risk management.
As his mentors, we strive to provide necessary guidance and advice while respecting his personality and talents, aiming to promote his comprehensive abilities, especially in teamwork and risk assessment. However, guiding him toward a more balanced and stable development path without weakening his innovative spirit and battlefield intuition is a challenging task." — Comprehensive End-of-Term Evaluation from Garland Military Academy

comment.text: So now I'm stuck cleaning up the mess those instructors left behind... What a pain.

stories.title: Knives Out
stories.text:
"Notice
During the Special Trial Unit's selection process, unregistered participant Dean Knight commandeered a training ST, bypassing security to compete. Showcasing remarkable talent, he outperformed many seasoned contenders.
Mr. Knight's actions, while demonstrating courage and skill, breached the selection's regulations, which require all participants to register beforehand to ensure fairness. Not yet a graduate of Garland Military Academy, he failed to meet the competition's eligibility criteria, thus unfairly disadvantaging officially registered competitors.
Given the above situation, although we fully recognize and respect Mr. Knight's talents and potential, as demonstrated in the selection event, we regret to announce that Mr. Knight's qualification for victory will be officially annulled according to the selection rules and procedures. We now await a decision on further punishment from the temporary jury formed by Council Member Lukmund." — DL Military Selection Committee

comment.text: According to eyewitnesses, Lukmund calmly tore the notice draft into pieces and announced on the spot the legality of Dean's promotion to the Special Trial Unit. He rarely makes such forceful decisions, but Dean's subsequent performance proved him right.

profile.label: Habits
profile.value: Enjoys field-stripping and reassembling heavy firearms to relax after work.

10103131.introduction: "During the war, I found myself trapped in a trench with two gunshot wounds in my left thigh, while Tiphys suffered a broken arm. We had to improvise medical care and managed to relay a critical intelligence message to prevent an NDF breach. He once shared a piece of timeless wisdom that has remained with me for decades: 'You cannot rest until the mission is accomplished.' Today, he is celebrated as a war hero of the DL, and the Milthus Battle he commanded is enshrined in the history books. Yet, he often reflects on the past, reminding us, 'What arrogance it is to praise honor built upon the lives of others.'" — Memoirs of a Senior DLAF Officer

stories.title: [Hazard]
stories.text: "Sorry, boss. Bastard slipped through our fingers... We worked him over for three days—nothing useful. But one of his boys cracked. Let a few things slip. Your gut was right—they're DLAF. The leader's Tiphys Mill, a lieutenant. They were posing as our contacts, trying to scam the goods for evidence—haul us in and dump us in a military tribunal! How did they get past all the checks when we've been working with 'them'? I've checked, and this Tiphys has no big name behind him. He was able to join this special establishment squad because of his outstanding combat performance and command ability, they say. Maybe he's the only one who overlooked our deal. Boss, we should just kill him. He's threatening our whole operation... Just now, he ran solo past the electric fence—straight into the damn minefield. Our guys are on him. If the bombs don't get him, I'm asking for clearance to finish the job myself." — [XXXX] Mercenary Group Communication Records

comment.text: You know, when we found the lieutenant, he was oozing blood from wounds all over his body, but he insisted on taking us back to fight and avenge those comrades who'd been tortured to death. They say he lay in the hospital for over a month after this. He was fantastic!

stories.title: [Build-up]
stories.text: "Once the big exercise kicked off, Lieutenant Colonel Mill became a regular in the command room. When duties weren't too demanding, he always came in low-key and sat in an inconspicuous corner to discuss the progress of the exercise with the others. He looked younger than the face I'd seen on the Wall of Honor—and far more serious. I was just a nobody, a service aide, but every time I brought him tea, my hands would tremble. He knew every officer by name, remembered their records by heart. He could watch the flow of the drills and predict each move like a chess master. By the end, it was the team he'd pegged from the start that took first place. I still remember the last time I cleared his cup. He suddenly said my name—my whole body locked up. Turns out, he just wanted to compliment my tea. Later, I heard most of the officers in that exercise ended up under his wing. Some people have all the luck." — Diary of a DLAF Orderly

comment.text: Can you believe it? That's me, right there! Alright, let me sneak in one more thing... I later met Lt. Col. Mill once again—by then, he had become a rear admiral. Hah! Don't even get me started. I'm not bragging or anything! Just thought I'd toss that in.

stories.title: [Father]
stories.text:
"After discussing Elise's advancement issue for an entire afternoon, we unanimously agreed that she is a highly talented child. Given her current knowledge reserves, we should really create more suitable learning conditions for her. After finalizing several suitable university options, Colonel Mill, who is usually expressionless, showed a few traces of worry. I fully understand this—after all, Elise is just a young girl who has recently entered high school. For parents, asking her to take such a leap so early is no easy emotional burden.
After the conversation, three things happened that deeply touched me. First, Colonel Mill asked, 'Do these schools require a letter of recommendation from me?' Second, he requested, 'The final decision needs to be thoroughly discussed between Elise and I. Please hold off on the submission for now.' Lastly, he asked, 'If Elise ultimately chooses to study away from home, as a father, what can I do to help prepare her for her new life?' It is genuinely moving to see such a devoted father. Elise should be able to go far in the future with a father like him..." — Work Record of a Well-Known Teacher in the DL

comment.text: Dad has always supported me, no matter what decisions I made. Maybe I could chase some far-off dream, but what I truly want is to give something back to him.

stories.title: [Ghost]
stories.text:
"Captured at the moment the Milthus Battle officially ended, this rare photograph shows General Mill, covered in blood, breaking through the haze of the battlefield and charging at the camera. Photographer Harry Brown, upon hearing the detonation of a landmine, pressed the shutter one last time—this would be the final image of his life. Brown was the last casualty of the Milthus Battle, and as fate would have it, Mill's image was the last to emerge from Harry's film.
After a fragile peace took hold, the crowds hailed their hero—Mill, the man who pulled the land from the jaws of hell. His name shone brighter than the sun, but he refused the glory, again and again. Perhaps in the hearts of many, the shadow of war had already dissipated along with the remains of those who were sacrificed, but a part of General Mill will forever be locked in the haze with that 'last photo.'" - Excerpt from the Military Documentary, Burning Milthus

10103133.introduction: Rosemary Jean, code-named "M," also known as "Madam." She is one of the most legendary agents in UNCS history and a seasoned bureaucrat holding multiple powerful positions, including GSA Director and Acting Viceroy of Milkhama. With the prestige she built in domestic affairs and intel warfare, Rosemary and her bureaucratic faction rapidly ascended in the post-war decade, gradually breaking the monopoly of political resources held by military oligarchs and traditional political families, and fostering the rise of a new wave of rising political stars.

stories.title: Fresh Wave
stories.text: "Sharp vision, a solid record, decisive methods, and refined leadership... It comes as no surprise that she will become the new helmsman of West Milkhama. Her judgment in personnel matters is particularly astonishing. Unproven island hackers. Foreign prisoners of complex background. Individuals with questionable records and diagnosed personality disorders. Alongside them, the mercenary outfits and entrenched local families of Milkhama Island... Due to classification restrictions, the author cannot yet present the full account of how this legendary director swept through the political arena, but judging from her personnel philosophy and political tactics alone, it is precisely her willingness to cut across convention—to operate at oblique angles—that allows her to outmaneuver traditional politicians. In doing so, she has injected rare new momentum into the UNCS political sphere, long monopolized by the military and aristocracy." —Rosemary's Legend

comment.text: An untested remote island hacker? Heh-heh... Noted. Wait for the UNCS investigator to come knocking at your door. Good luck!

stories.title: Wrist
stories.text: "The current situation surprises me not in the slightest—it's all because my dear committee members somehow believed that a handful of military restriction clauses could stop Rosemary. We've struggled against this old woman for years—do we really still fail to understand her resolve and methods? Look at the NDF forces stationed on the island. They're a farce. They think that refusing cooperation somehow restrains her. In reality, all they've done is handcuff themselves. Even the Electric Eels, the Luno Family, and the nobodies from the GKD Parcel Service are speaking up on the NDF's behalf—and their appearances are more effective than official deployments. At this rate, one day the island's bandits, mercenaries, and even armored units will become Rosemary's private guard, while the military department congratulates itself on a job well done." —UNCS Internal Meeting Record

comment.text: Political factions and war maniacs come and go, but in the end, they paved the way for someone like Rosemary, who comes from a purely bureaucratic system... The political climate of the UNCS is about to change!

stories.title: Vengeance
stories.text: The conflict between Rosemary and the military predates Milkhama by many years. Rumors persist that during the Battle of Milthus—the engagement that reshaped Milkhama Island's future—the GSA, with Rosemary serving as wartime intelligence officer, had already decrypted information confirming Obsidian and DL troop concentrations in Milthus. For reasons still unknown, this intelligence was never delivered to the landing force. The result was a catastrophic NDF failure—one that altered not only Milkhama's history, but arguably world history itself. This unresolved grievance ignited a prolonged internal struggle between the UNCS General Security Administration and the NDF. When Blair returned to power, his first directive was the systematic purge of all GSA forces on Milkhama. Rosemary exploited the escalating three-way confrontation, gradually extending her reach beyond the GSA—until she finally settled accounts with Blair on Milkhama, completing a vendetta nearly twenty years in the making. —Special Segment, Inside the NDF

comment.text: These ridiculous conspiracy theories need to stop! The truth is that Blair, the commander of the landing forces, acted on his own, imprisoned and plotted against the agent transmitting intelligence to the front lines, launched an unauthorized assault on Milthus, and was wiped out by the enemy. On the day of Blair's death, the GSA transmitted the council's order to "bring back Blair Bluecher." His death resulted from Arnold's directive to encircle and intercept, combined with Raven Bluecher's refusal to comply. This was a strictly personal incident—nothing more!

stories.title: Friend or Foe
stories.text: "What makes her truly terrifying is that we can't see her desires. We don't know what she wants—nor what she intends to do. Her record only tells you this: a civilian born during the baby boom. After her father, a newspaper editor, died, she inherited his work. To support a sick mother and a young brother, she became an investigative journalist for better pay. A few minor but influential cases led her into intelligence work, after which she was thrown into the economic investigation division like expendable fodder. By the time she resurfaced, she had become the old director's 'black goat.' No one remembers how she climbed that far. And when everyone finally realized what was happening, even the old director had been personally dealt with—yet no one inside the agency believed she had betrayed him. The evidence was clear. The methods, precise. The motive remains a mystery. She can be an enemy. She can be a friend. But she must be neither. That is what makes her truly dangerous." —Interview with a Retired GSA Agent

10103134.introduction: Individual identification code "Phantom Pain," a mysterious mercenary who suddenly appeared after the Blair Rebellion. Her true identity is Aynis Newman, the daughter of Dr. Newman, who was declared deceased many years ago. Under the arrangement of UNCS GSA Director Rosemary Jean, she returned to Milkhama under the name of her late mother, "Ophelia." A new generation Hyper-Aptamer with an excellent Sync Ratio, she is willful, arrogant, and rebellious, seemingly holding many secrets. Her actions and objectives are entirely unknown, but the only certainty is her intense hostility toward Kaidan Newman.

stories.title: Aynis Newman
stories.text: "Today, Aynis snuck into the Research Institute again, hiding in the food delivery cart to evade the guards... With such strong curiosity and initiative, I really don't know which side this child takes after more. Fortunately, Goman discovered her quickly and prevented her from seeing those horrifying experiments. I'm not yet prepared to explain all of this to her. Although Aynis tearfully explained that she just wanted to help me, Ophelia uncharacteristically became very angry. She never inquires about my research, but she absolutely does not want her daughter involved in it... In this regard, I share the same sentiment." —Walter Newman Related Recovery Data Entry 13255

stories.title: Another "Prototype"
stories.text: "Aynis and Kaidan have made contact. Although neither of them confirmed each other's identity, this brief exchange has already gone against my initial expectations. I had planned to arrange a proper meeting for them to officially become family once everything settled down, but this sudden incident disrupted my plans... Even worse, the activated Nova-Frame reacted to Aynis, with sensors capturing unprecedented high values. This means that not only Kaidan, but even Aynis has the potential to become a 'Prototype'... It is the worst possibility—one I should have foreseen, yet never wished to face." —Walter Newman Related Recovery Data Entry 34711

comment.text: So the girl from that time was her... That was the only time we met. Looking back, it must have been my father's deliberate attempt to prevent further contact between us. It was to protect the secret of the Hyper-Aptamer and to protect all of us.

stories.title: Hostage
stories.text:
"I failed. Blair somehow obtained the data that was supposed to be deleted, and discovered Aynis's potential as a Hyper-Aptamer. He also uncovered my secret plan for escape. The forced transfer of Ophelia and Aynis under the guise of a 'safety drill' was his last warning to me. Perhaps I should give up here... However, the fate of Kaidan and the Diaz sisters also depends on my choice. Hmm...? Who could it be at this hour? Aynis? What are you doing here? What? My birthday? Just for that? ...
No, thank you, good girl. Don't cry. It will be all right. Daddy promises... I will protect all of you, no matter what..." —Walter Newman Related Recovered Data Entry 83906

comment.text: Filthy liar.

stories.text: "Test concluded, ∑-04 emerged the victor, ∑-07's cockpit completely shattered. Logistics team, remember to clean up thoroughly... I never expected such an outcome. It took over six years to complete the entire Hyper-Aptamer Renovation, and we had no expectations for ∑-04. However, during the field test, her Sync Ratio reached an astonishing 92%. I've never seen such a high value in anyone outside Valkyrie. Is this due to the individual's innate potential, or have we inadvertently grasped the key to technical iteration? Either way, it means we still have hope for a reversal. According to the latest intelligence from Milkhama, Governor Blair probably won't hold out much longer. I must produce results quickly... If what that agent said is true, the General Security Administration should be willing to protect us. Before that, I must find a way to address ∑-04's rebellious and disobedient nature. Hopefully, increasing 'authority' can eliminate her instability as a weapon." —Hyper-Aptamer 9th Research Institute Experiment Record

comment.text: Test Subject ∑-04 has been confirmed for retrieval and is expected to be deployed directly to Milkhama after adjustments are completed. Additionally, based on personal preference, the operational codename has been designated as "Ophelia."

10103135.introduction: A polite young man, his good manners and industriousness make him the best representative for both the "Madam" and the UNCS GSA. Much is said of his origins. Some say he is the eldest son of a family of agents, others claim he is an orphan who received secret training, and some even suggest he is a descendant of a fallen royal family or a kept man by the "Madam"... None of these stories can accurately define Smiths Anderson. He himself is indifferent to this gossip, viewing society from the outside in, constantly switching between different personas, playing roles, adapting to different situations and expectations as need be. The only regrettable aspect is his somewhat outdated personal taste, such as collecting old jokes, which has earned him the nickname "Cheesy Charmer" among his colleagues.

stories.title: Performance Preparation
stories.text: Empty Shell was the unanimous name given to him by the adults at the institution, and it was the name he held the longest during his childhood. At that time, he was silent and reserved, yet possessed a sensitivity to understand people's hearts and a strictness towards himself. No matter how difficult the rules were, he could adhere to them meticulously, and no matter how challenging the problems were, he could overcome them perfectly. Because he never showed his emotions, he resembled a perfect doll more than a child of his age. Due to this flawless pretense of obedience, several families took him in as an adopted child, but it wasn't long before he was returned by his guardians. "It's terrifying! We gave him care and affection, yet he never responded like a child. He'd mirror it back at us, like a hollow reflection, as if he were acting. The uncanny feeling... it's demonic!" The adults invariably raged at the person in charge, claiming they were deceived by the institution. But only he and the institution's caretaker who always looked after him knew that this was merely his carefully calculated escape technique, a necessary preparation for the next role he would play.

comment.text: We have reminded you of this child's peculiarity. He is not good with words, shows no expression, and cannot express emotions... Yet anyone would be deceived by his appearance, thinking that with love, he would be different. But in reality, he is just learning and mimicking the ways of life of all the humans he sees, unconsciously displaying them... Sigh... Thinking of how he silently followed behind us, I still get chills down my spine.

stories.title: Backstage Organization
stories.text: A shabby apartment, a cozy cottage, a luxurious mansion... It no longer matters where he goes or whom he faces, for he will ultimately return to his own humble abode. Through constant travels and living under others' roofs, he learns the different ways of human life. And he always manages to discern the subtle weaknesses of human nature at the moment of mastery, escaping by provoking his adopters... When an old butler named "Smiths Anderson" brings him to a new residence, he is mentally prepared to be returned once again. Yet, a day, a week, a month pass, long enough for him to almost forget how to count time, and he still hasn't met the "Lady" the servants speak of—his nominal adopter. "The Lady has taken a liking to your talent, [Child]... If you can imitate anyone, you can become anyone..." "Become a mirror to the world," is the only response the old butler, who calls himself Smith, ever gives to the "empty shell's" inquiries, day after day teaching him everything from business studies, negotiation, physical skills, to scouting. He tirelessly pursues perfection, driven by a newly-sprouted emotion: curiosity.

comment.text: He is the child the lady has been most satisfied with so far. Even the usually stubborn Mr. Smith rarely showed a gentle attitude, privately reminding us countless times to treat him with the status of 'Young Master.'

stories.title: Welcome Speech
stories.text: Miss... no, when meeting the source of his curiosity, the old butler had him change it to "Madam." [Madam] was different from those adults who sought emotional returns by posing as parents. Instead, she treated him as an equal. He could read from [Madam]'s attitude that this person was not afraid of his hollow self and accepted him wholeheartedly. During his days with [Madam], he played the roles of doorman, waiter, chef, bodyguard, advisor, lover, and even rival... As for his true nature, intelligence reports seized from the enemy poured in like snowflakes, yet not a single one could capture him in full... "Now, it's time for you to take up the name Smiths Anderson..." This was his last meeting with the old butler. the white-haired "Smiths Anderson" handed him a delicate antique pistol and a UNCS Bounty Medal with a ribbon. It was also from that moment that the "hollow" had a name of his own for the first time, "Smiths Anderson."

comment.text: "Smiths Anderson," the legendary agent codename of the UNCS! It has been active for hundreds of years! But even I don't know exactly how many "Smiths Andersons" there have been. In any case, many of the deeds associated with this codename have almost become urban legends. Perhaps the soon-to-be-released "Smith 009: The Golden Left Hand," based on a true story, will provide some reliable clues?

stories.title: Performance Begins
stories.text: Smiths Anderson arrives in Milkhama as the sole accompanying advisor appointed by [Madam], endowed with executive power second only to her. His principle of maintaining exceptional efficiency is to never do anything unnecessary during work. To gather intelligence, he always manages to connect with various figures on the island. "Fate is both the beginning of fortune and misfortune," the previous Smiths Anderson once advised him. To avoid causing unnecessary trouble for the GSA, he constantly switches between different personas to handle surrounding affairs. As [Madam]'s "other side," as the eyes and dagger of the GSA, and as part of the UNCS's will, he operates with an enigmatic identity in various settings across Milkhama—just like the old butler once did. After all, no matter how perilous the task, for "Smiths Anderson," it's merely going through the motions.

10103136.introduction: Erisa Shinohara, an escaped Hyper-Aptamer during the NDF turmoil, is known as "Ubiquitous Rain" in various media and military networks. Her news reports consistently carry astonishing and thought-provoking content, often likened to an unforeseen needle piercing some individuals' most guarded secrets. While her whereabouts remain mysterious, adorned with equipment and a reassuring smile, her appearance invariably signals the imminent arrival of groundbreaking revelations.

stories.title: Ubiquitous
stories.text: "Sir, I'm concerned that the discussion surrounding 'Ubiquitous Rain' wasn't quite thorough enough. This oversight could come to bite us. Her recent disclosures have triggered a wave of public backlash; many senior UNCS officials have come under fire. Although the DL may welcome such developments, we must not underestimate the risks inherent in this kind of journalism, free from institutional oversight. Based on our previous contact with this 'Ubiquitous Rain,' she seems to dive into danger headfirst, like a moth to flame... The latest intelligence shows that her activity area has spread right to the heart of the DL. Sir, it may be time to take action." — DL News Agency Editorial Board Minutes

stories.title: Rainy
stories.text: "Judging from the movements of 'Ubiquitous Rain,' she seems interested in military activities. We have spotted her at three bombing sites, but each time she managed to slip away. To ensure we wouldn't miss her again, we requested police support. We setup ambushes at several key locations determined by her psychological and behavioral profile. Finally, we were able to detain the target. However, when confronted by the interrogator, her attitude was... intriguing. She showed no surprise at her arrest and was very frank in answering our questions. She even volunteered details we didn't ask for. She casually asked for you, Chief Editor, and even invited our team out for tea... *cough* Our experts concluded that she was telling the truth, though it's difficult to comprehend. Also, as you know, she somehow managed to steal a police ST, and now she's on the wanted list. I'm sure she'll be caught soon... Well, maybe..." — Communication Record on DL News Agency Editor-in-Chief's Terminal

comment.text: What? Arrested?! Isn't this supposed to be an "official prison visit" organized by the DL for the press? Who the hell's updating my Skynet info?

stories.title: Wind Roar
stories.text: "5th Adaptive Experiment, Subject No. 13 performed exceptionally well and may soon be able to advance to the next phase. No. 13 has also expressed a willingness to communicate. This is the first time she has taken the initiative to communicate since being 'recruited' into the lab. We had a simple conversation, and I was eager to know her sensory feedback after being modified. However, her language system has been damaged, making it difficult for her to express herself adequately. She was interested in my nameplate and work manual, but I couldn't show her any confidential content. I resorted to giving her my name. Her expression became softer than ever before, and she uttered a coherent syllable. It was only later that I realized that this might be her name. She clumsily wrote a series of crooked characters in the palm of my hand with my pen, with not much skill at all. I have decided that from today onwards, I might customize a language course for her so that she might at least be comfortable during this frustratingly endless life of experimentation." — Excerpt from Subject No. 13 Observation Report

comment.text: Girls... ST... experiment... Why do these words feel so familiar when I put them together? Could they be related to Sylvie and the other girls too?

stories.title: Spring Green
stories.text: "In my hometown, people live a secluded life. They work during the day and sleep at night, and the sun and moon turn endlessly amidst the monotony. The adults in the village are like trees and flowers, while the elderly are like withered branches and fallen leaves. I'm just like a seed of grass, caught in this infinite cycle. 'What else can we do? It's not that bad,' my mother always says. She's right. There's no room for contemplation in this life, no room for sorrow either. One winter, a blind and disabled stranger came to the village. He said he used to be a soldier and had spent his days in the military. Now that he was old, he wanted to change his way of life. He liked the leisurely life in the village. I didn't understand. Life here wasn't leisurely at all. Time passed quickly, and before I knew it, I had grown up. He laughed and said I didn't know many words, so how could I understand what leisurely meant. I blushed and went home, but I couldn't help but go talk to him again the next day. As I listened to him boast, I began understanding the elusive concept of 'leisure' in the warm and cold months. As the last of the snow melted, he gazed down the mountain path and remarked that the way was now clear and easy to travel. At that moment, I felt like I was sprouting anew... Indeed, spring was coming." — Excerpt from The Life and Lies of Milkhama

comment.text: If she hadn't chosen to leave the village back then, she'd probably still be living that peaceful life... Changing your life requires great strength. The little girl who used to cry in my arms—she's grown up.

profile.label: Likes
profile.value: Electronic Music, Dark Fairy Tales, and Sachertorte

profile.label: Published Work
profile.value: From Heiress to Helldriver: The Fall of a Noble House

10103137.introduction: Fia Helstota, a Hyper-Aptamer escapee from a UNCS lab, now works as Erisa's assistant, projecting a princess-like air. She handles Erisa's challenging tasks under the guise of receiving industry training but ends up caring for Erisa's daily needs due to her refined upbringing. Despite voicing her grievances to Erisa, Fia has not received effective feedback.

stories.title: Promised Land
stories.text: "In Ovett's distant past, there was once a place known as the Promised Land... A determined pioneer living in the frozen north stood defiant, dreaming of reshaping the land for human survival. The pioneer embarked on an arduous journey, infecting many young people with his spirit of fearlessness and hope along the way. The frozen land gradually revealed the miraculous resources he had sought, and the pioneer fulfilled his initial promise, settling down with his companions for generations to come. Their descendants continued to uphold the fearless spirit of that first generation, maintaining this land of hope." — Excerpt from Ovett Regional Story

comment.text: The legendary Helstota clan of Ovett, pioneers of the frozen wastelands... I always thought it was just a kids' fairy tale, and now you're telling me there's an actual heir?

stories.title: Girl
stories.text: "However, humans cannot easily alter nature's laws. In the end, all living beings remain bound to the roles of hunter and hunted. Even if humans have acquired civilization, their cruel nature is still deeply ingrained in their souls and cannot be disobeyed. The outsiders claimed they were drawn by the Promised Land, offering warm words and smiles that looked sincere. But when their eyes finally opened, the venom had already sunk in, and those outsiders clung to their prey like vipers, devouring all their accumulated achievements. The people tried their best, but all their efforts were in vain. Reality ground the last shred of pride from the pioneers' bloodline into dust. In the end, a girl—not even grown—was elected as their temporary leader, and to stand against the storm, she made her choice and signed a contract with the devil..." — Unburnt Notebook Fragment

comment.text: Whether it's dignity or downfall, it all falls on the shoulders of a young girl? Fate's got a hell of a sense of humor... But this is different from the Ovett storybook I grew up reading... What is this, some grimdark rewrite?

stories.title: Hero
stories.text: "After all, this is not a fairy tale. The girl's stubborn will did not restore what her family had lost. After enduring seemingly endless physical and mental torment in the purgatory of her fate, she abandoned all hope of survival. She believed she no longer had a right to respond to anyone's expectations, and could only watch as her family became mere minions of the Snake, their lineage reduced to just another trophy on display. The weak cannot go against fate—a truth known well by all Ovettians. Who would extend a hand to the powerless? This is the real world, not a children's story... Perhaps only the most hopeless of fools would recklessly extend a hand to others—as she had once done..." — Unsent Private letter

comment.text: Trophies? For those test subjects they drag in, "tools" paints a truer picture of what they are... But if they survive the gauntlet—trial after trial—and claw their way to the top... they become "art."

stories.title: Enemy
stories.text:
"Later, that foolish hero and his companions went to the demon's lair together and liberated countless suffering maidens. The hero inspired the girls, returning to them their freedom and reigniting their fighting spirit. Thus, they embarked on a new journey together. But this, of course, is merely a standard fairytale ending, and nothing more.
Life is like an Ovett nesting doll—you never know if what comes next will bring fortune or disaster. The blood in her veins constantly reminds her of her duty as a descendant of those trailblazers. And so, opportunity arises once more, fate destined to rekindle the bond that was once severed. If it meant justice for her family, then even becoming the villain was a duty she would fulfill. All for Helstota." — Dusty Diary of a Young Girl

comment.text: You went so far as to write an entire story just to express what you've been through? Was it through such fantasies that you were able to endure those cruel experiments? Well, the decline of Helstota was inevitable, but only someone like me, who doesn't care about social status, would dare to continue treating you as a friend. Keep up the good work, Fia.

profile.label: Notable Feats
profile.value: Also earned the title of "Boss" after crushing ten so-called "warlords."

10103138.introduction: "Who are you looking for? Oh, Lorna? She should be out on patrol with her dad right now! You know, that little rascal—when she was first brought in, I could have picked her up with one hand. I had no idea how much she'd grown since then! Just please keep this between us; I don't want her to find out I said anything. The last thing I need is to be hounded by her and end up living in an ST!" —A Milkhaman from the DL Colony

stories.title: Patrol Officer
stories.text: "After speaking with many locals, I came upon Lorna Mahalim teaching some troublemakers a lesson. She was indeed as energetic and agile as everyone had said. Even though she was just a child, she had already begun to use her fists to uphold justice in her neighborhood. Lorna was very cautious when I, a stranger, arrived and kept questioning my intentions. She looked at my press card more than ten times before reluctantly trusting my identity. The environment in the autonomous region is chaotic, which would make for good exposure material. I wanted to take more photos, but Lorna stopped me... She was protecting the last refuge of the native Milkhaman in her own way... So I understood that if I wanted to complete this interview smoothly, I might need to show more understanding and goodwill." —Excerpt from a DL Journalist's Memoirs, Unfading Light in the Night

comment.text: Hey, I know this book! It's pretty well-written, but I wonder why they stopped publishing them... I hear some experts called it "inaccurate," but those bookworms haven't even been out to the borderlands before.

stories.title: The Flower of Hope
stories.text: "On the fourteenth day, after helping her deliver two truck-loads of drinking water, Lorna finally accepted the Ms. Chili Soda I offered. We leaned against a truck tire, drinking our beverages and watching the sunset. Then she told me her story—being abandoned at birth, adopted by the autonomous region's leader, growing up under the care of the refugees, and being given the surname "Mahalim" shared by the orphans of Milkhama. When she introduced herself, she smiled and looked up, the excitement of drinking soda for the first time shining in her eyes like pride. At that moment, I understood why every citizen I had interviewed before would express a hint of tenderness when mentioning Lorna—this child was a beautiful flower they had worked hard to cultivate in this barren soil, bringing with her something called "hope." —Excerpt from a DL Journalist's Memoirs, Unfading Light in the Night

comment.text: *sigh* I never thought that this little she-devil had such a difficult childhood... I'll take her out for drinks—real drinks! Uh, and two more truckloads of Ms. Chili Soda!

stories.title: Milkhamanesque
stories.text: "I asked Lorna if she had ever considered leaving the autonomous zone. She was still just a child, and perhaps she could leave this chaotic land and seek out some local immigrants in other areas willing to adopt her. But the little girl quickly gave me a negative answer, saying, 'This is my home, where my family lives. I won't go anywhere. I will protect the people here.' She was so young, but this land she grew up in, with its many trials and tribulations, had already given her a sense of self completely different from her peers in the outside world. She sat in the cockpit of the ST like an adult, shuttling through the alleys of the autonomous zone to uphold justice like the wind and sowing the seeds of hope in people's hearts like a hero... Perhaps in the future, she is destined to once again face the flames of war like all Milkhamans." —Excerpt from a DL Journalist's Memoirs, Unfading Light in the Night

stories.title: Dawn's Faint Light
stories.text: "At the end of the interview, I requested a group photo, which Lorna unsurprisingly declined. However, this time, she was not as straightforward and stern as before. She seemed hesitant and shy, with a hint of regret deep in her eyes. She escorted me to the front gate as if urging me to leave. Before parting ways, I left my contact information in case the child wanted a way out in the future. She did not accept it. Perhaps in this chaotic era, no one can truly establish order, but Lorna still believes that the peace her family has longed for will eventually come. 'I will witness that day with my own eyes,' she said. As I watched her continue to rush around, I suddenly found myself also looking forward to the future she believed in." — Excerpt 4 from a DL Journalist's Memoirs, Unfading Light in the Night

comment.text: Civilians shouldn't be the ones paying the price for war. We've got to take down the people stirring the pot—fast. That's the only way Lorna and her family will ever have a shot at what they've been dreaming of...

10103139.introduction: Matilda Rossi, former commander of the 35th Battalion, 1st Mobile Division of the Milkhama Landing Forces, now the Chief Commander of the Island Defense Forces. She is carefree, open-minded, cheerful, confident, and has strong opinions. Occasionally, she may appear overly assertive in disputes, but she genuinely cares for her subordinates and enjoys a good reputation among the lower ranks and civilians, making her a compassionate commander. Additional note: If you don't consider her sloppy nature, her driving style that skirts the edge of regulations, and her tactical inclination toward firepower supremacy... she quite fits the title of "Flower of the Defense Force."

stories.title: Primary Exclusion
stories.text:
Some say the DLAF is currently in an awkward transitional phase. The older generation of DLAF, which rose during the unification period and shone in the border wars, is gradually aging. Meanwhile, the newcomers from the academic background severely lack practical combat experience. Especially after the "treason" of Mill and his son, the situation in East Milkhama has become increasingly dire, and the DL cannot find anyone to regain control of the NDF amidst the chaos. This has led many in the DL to worry about who can rise to the occasion, unify the fragmented organization and faction-ridden DLAF, and safeguard the border and East Milkhama's security as the border confrontation intensifies.
Perhaps those in the Oceanic Conclave each have their own answers, but everyone instinctively excludes that name... "Matilda Rossi might be competent—but let's leave it at that. The DL is not yet so desperate as to have no one else worth considering. We should be looking at candidates with greater potential."

stories.title: Inactive Division
stories.text: Is Matilda Rossi a worthless pilot or commander? The answer is unequivocally no. In fact, contrary to the attitude of certain DL leaders, Matilda enjoys a solid reputation and considerable personal authority within the DLAF. Decorated veterans and rising academy officers alike regard her—at least in matters of military affairs—as an exceptional professional. She fought on the front lines during the border wars and went on to distinguish herself in several armed clashes that followed the war. By any reasonable standard, she represents a critical pillar of the current DLAF. And yet, her path to promotion has been anything but smooth. At one point, she was even reassigned to an idle rear-area department in the homeland—far removed from the front lines and the centers of achievement.

stories.title: Higher Priority
stories.text: The reason Matilda is unpopular among politicians is simple: she is not an obedient officer willing to subordinate herself to the civilian system. The institutional histories of the DLAF and the NDF are fundamentally different. Since its founding, the DL has never allowed a military faction with sufficient political weight to emerge. The armed forces exist strictly as an external instrument of political power, fully subject to civilian command and deployment. Matilda—this "highly individualistic" mid-level officer—has repeatedly found ways to resist, reinterpret, or outright bypass civilian decisions in pursuit of what she considers more effective military outcomes. From the standpoint of results, her unauthorized actions have, in most cases, proven the wiser choice. But procedural violations leave paper trails. Over time, these accumulated records became the very tools senators and politicians used to attack her. As a result, Matilda was transferred into "more important" positions—positions that conveniently kept her away from the front—and remained politically sidelined for years.

comment.text: Ahem... It would be unreasonable to expect proper procedure from someone insane enough to outfit a Light ST with a heavy machine gun.

stories.title: Chaotic Talent
stories.text:
Ultimately, Matilda was pulled into the chaos of Milkhama regardless. What began as a vacation on the island turned abruptly into crisis when unrest triggered by Vesper erupted. The military-political fracture within DL jurisdiction, combined with the rebellion of Mill and his son, sent East Milkhama into rapid freefall. Acting on instinct and training, Matilda immediately assumed command of the disordered defense camp. Drawing on her personal authority, she reunified the island's scattered mobile units and secured the backing of emerging political forces represented by Shawnee. As East Milkhama descended further into instability—and with the NDF watching closely from across the line—even the aging parliamentary holdouts who had initially opposed her appointment were forced to concede. Matilda was approved as the acting DLAF commander of Milkhama Island.
At times, even Matilda herself could not help but reflect on the pattern. Always drawn to the center of chaos—perhaps that, too, was a kind of talent.

profile.label: Previous Occupation
profile.value: Captain of the Black Shark Special Forces

10103141.introduction: A distinguished DLAF officer from the Dawnstar League homeland, Kelly is widely recognized as a composed and razor-sharp elite sniper. She is often hailed as the most unpredictable wild card on the battlefield, capable of utilizing any vantage point to shift the tide in her favor. Despite her seemingly nonchalant attitude in everyday life and her disheveled appearance when traveling with Diracca, her unparalleled lethality on the battlefield is never in question by her allies or enemies. One recollection from a reprimanded recruit vividly captures the sense of constant surveillance she exudes: "It feels like those eagle-eyes never leave you for a second."

stories.title: Can't Have It All
stories.text: Kelly Polis has been in the spotlight since she was a child, with outstanding achievements, an exquisite appearance, and incredible eyesight. At age ten, she could accurately hit a criminal fifty meters away with a slingshot. Cloaked in accolades, Kelly was a regular recipient of scholarships during her student days, but surprisingly, this elite pupil had few friends. Perhaps it was because people were not used to Kelly's cold personality, or they were jealous of her talents. Surrounding Kelly were not only flowers and applause but also countless idle rumors. Kelly didn't like to waste time on useless things and gradually became accustomed to being alone until...

stories.title: Unpredictable
stories.text: During her college years, Kelly attended the most prestigious local university as an outstanding student representative for a three-month exchange program. During that time, she met her equally accomplished roommate, Shawnee Russell. Shawnee's appearance undoubtedly enriched Kelly's extracurricular life. They studied and discussed situations and communicated their opinions, and Kelly even discussed shooting techniques with Shawnee for the first time. She even learned her first ballroom dance from Shawnee. Despite their different styles, they got along very well. Although their time together was short, and Kelly did not fully understand all that the name "Shawnee Russell" encompassed, she still cherished this friendship and secretly awaited their reunion.

stories.title: Talent Shines
stories.text: After graduation, Kelly joined the DLAF. Due to her outstanding combat prowess, she quickly became an elite sniper in the Black Shark Special Forces. In the DLAF, where strength determines one's position, Kelly felt at home, and gradually gathered many followers around her. Over the years, Kelly and her squad achieved numerous glorious victories, becoming a genuinely elite combat unit. During breaks from her missions, Kelly occasionally reminisced about the golden times she spent with her old friend. She never imagined that their reunion had already been set in motion.

comment.text: The famous "Black Sharks." I heard the coach talk about this special forces unit when I was at Enfield. The team members risk their lives to carry out missions—even the entrance exam is notoriously brutal. I never thought Kelly came from there. No wonder she was the only one who felt my performance wasn't up to par during the joint training competition. If I only had another chance...

stories.title: Turbulent Depths
stories.text: On the rainy night her transfer orders arrived, Kelly spent the entire evening at the shooting range. The terminal on her desk stayed on until morning, displaying just one short email, signed with a beautiful cursive signature—"Shawnee Russell." Kelly never thought she would reconnect with her long-lost friend in this way, nor did she expect that Shawnee would become the security chief of the DL's jurisdiction on Milkhama and that this transfer order was her doing. Kelly couldn't understand what made that perilous, unpredictable island so alluring. What was it that drew someone as gifted as Shawnee, enough to make her willingly abandon the comfort and prestige of life in the Dawnstar Alliance? In the end, doubts and longing drove Kelly to set foot on the scorched earth of Milkhama, and she looked forward to the answers that time would bring, even if the road ahead was paved with cinders and gunfire.

comment.text: I don't know whether to admire the security officer's foresight for the smooth development of the situation to this point, or marvel that a friendship this rare could bloom in a place like this.

profile.label: Favorite Book
profile.value: A Complete History of the UNCS

profile.label: Gossip
profile.value: Rumored to have once won an underground tournament in Kadrey.

10103144.introduction: "I first laid eyes on Vincenza Luno at the DR. ROYAL in Kadrey. Doll was marking the opening of its 100th DR hotel, and the city's most powerful names had gathered for the celebration. The moment Vincenza stepped into the room, every eye turned toward her. People whispered, wondering why Doll's largest rival in Kadrey had shown up. Faced with hostile, heavily armed Doll security, she merely offered a faint smile and snapped her fingers. In the next instant, headlights flared and engines roared to life. Hundreds of biker enforcers stood ready outside. The guards could only watch as she mounted the back of a female rider's bike, then the convoy circled the hotel three times before thundering off into the night. That was the moment I knew—war had come." —Testimony of Undercover Kadrey Police Agent X.W.

stories.title: Underworld Heiress
stories.text: There is no doubt that when Vincenza was young, she was a naive, happy, adorable little girl. She excelled in school and would happily play with friends after class—everyone thought she was a good child. It was only when the news leaked our that her father had connections to the underworld that, gradually, her childhood friends began distancing themselves from her in fear, and the teachers at school began treating her with an obsequious level of respect and attention. Even during the youth baseball games, the umpires would constantly look to her for approval before making a call. No one dared touch her, but no one dared to approach her either. After a large-scale turf war on Flogg Street, her daily outings could only be conducted with the accompaniment of bodyguards— a complete departure from her old life as an ordinary girl.

stories.title: The Game Board
stories.text: Alone and without friends, Vincenza immersed herself in books and chess. Through the pages of old texts and game records, she felt as though she could converse with minds from the past, learning their thoughts and temperaments. A player's character always reveals itself on the board—bold and decisive, swift and fluid, cautious and defensive, timid and uncertain. Each move whispers something about the player's life, and perhaps their future. Vincenza's own style is a web of traps. When it seems she is quietly defending, a hidden strike force is already waiting in some forgotten corner of the board, ready to deliver the fatal blow.

stories.title: Successor
stories.text:
"Are we really going to go along with that old fox from the GSA and replace the leader with Vincenza?"
"The boss has already decided. It's being announced at tomorrow's meeting. Or are you planning to vote against it?"
"...This isn't just his family's business. I'm the youngest here, so I'll just say it—it's wrong!"
"I know. The current territory and business were built by all the brothers together. If Boss Luno insists on this, I'll lead the brothers to start our own group."
—Excerpt from GSA Surveillance Records

comment.text: At the time, we received more than thirty recordings. From them, we obtained evidence of crimes committed by several key members of the Luno family, including murder, smuggling, tax evasion...

stories.title: Vision
stories.text:
Genovese Luno failed after charging at the immovable windmill, but Vincenza is determined not to repeat her father's mistakes. Despite the Doll Group's constraints and the GSA's oversight, even if the path is thorny, she is resolute in securing a place for the Luno Family in the turbulent future. 
She voluntarily stepped away from the lights of Kadrey, to listen to the wails echoing from the shadows... the lonely elderly in community hospitals, the homeless children in old industrial areas, the workers selling their strength at the old docks, and even the outlaws who cannot survive in the light. While they seek sustenance, they continuously provide energy to the Luno Family. Vincenza understands that to realize her vision, she must recruit and utilize every possible ally...

10103146.introduction:
"After the Disconnect Surgery and continued diary-keeping, Camilla's memory has improved, enabling her to recall events from the past five days. We can gradually reduce her daily MM44 dosage while continuing to monitor her closely. Our main priority is to stabilize her basic self-care skills and maintain her progress.
Therefore, we will postpone the plan to enhance her combat endurance and concentrate on further developing her skills based on the Rebirth Experiment." —An Anonymous Report

stories.title: What is Perfection?
stories.text:
"Perfection is subjective, defined by perception. Today's focus is on the crucial process of obtaining subjects.
The conventional sourcing of subjects often results in variable quality, requiring time-consuming filtering to find suitable candidates without ensuring high-quality outcomes, leading to wasted time and research resources.
The Rebirth Experiment offers a solution, using an agent infused with α matter to eliminate unstable factors and create flawless "masterpieces."
Of course, we've gotten over that hump and managed to boost our success rate by an impressive 50%." — Rebirth Experiment Presentation Materials

comment.text: This short statement convinced Managing Director Raphael—thus, the Predators were born.

stories.title: Her Life
stories.text:
"June 21st.
Subject No. 14's absorption of the newly developed Arashi agent has been completed, with no noticeable rejection reactions, no autophagy, and normal bodily functions. (Note: This individual may have a high tolerance for α matter.)
We have begun to "redraw" her memories without direct human contact, and she is learning the language very quickly—she will soon move on to the next phase. (I'll follow up on this experiment, so please don't let those idiots bother me.)
...The experiment will proceed in seven phases, like the seven days of divine creation. I have often wondered if, perhaps, in the distant past, God was doing the exact same thing I am now..." — Subject No. 14 Observation Report, Part One

stories.title: Last Moment
stories.text:
"November 13th.
No. 14's body is saturated with α matter, but her upper limit has surpassed that of the prior prime subject, and the experiment will be transitioning into its final phase. Before proceeding to the final phase, I need to put her into the "Hunting Ground," allowing her to spend time with the inferior subjects to develop some necessary social skills or camouflage for any collaboration or infiltration missions that may exist in the future.
While this may introduce variables into the experiment, it doesn't worry me. In the final phase of the Disconnect Surgery, I will fine-tune this memory of hers—these imperfections will be erased, and everything will return to the path I have envisioned." — Report on the Transfer of Subject No. 14

stories.title: New Beginning
stories.text:
"Camilla Cursed has completed all tests and regulatory training, although she failed several times in social assessments, which indirectly verifies her ability to be higher than that of ordinary people. Now, I propose that instead of continuing to use her as a failed experimental sample for meaningless research, she should be included in the Obsidian Mobile Guard for missions.
The Rebirth Experiment should not be mentioned again, and her designation as Subject No. 14 should be left in the past. From now on, she will remain under my custodianship and will directly obey my orders. I will also be responsible for all related affairs." — Transfer Application Letter

10103149.introduction: Asuka Shikinami Langley, the pilot of EVA Unit-02 from another world. A remarkable prodigy, her skills turn heads whether she's on Milkhama or in her homeland. After quickly adapting to Milkhama's Arashium STs, Asuka ventured behind enemy lines to the East Desert, rescuing her companions trapped by enemy forces.

stories.title: Suspicious Pilot
stories.text: "Target Asuka Shikinami Langley, discovered near the Northern Mining Zone in the Foren Lake area. Claims to be an Evangelion unit pilot from another world. In an encounter, she single-handedly defeated ten of our Steel Puppets using only one mass-produced DL unit, nearly breaking our encirclement... We highly suspect that she is a test subject on the run from DL or other unknown forces. All departments must immediately monitor any clues related to this suspected test subject, and report credible evidence to the agency immediately." — GSA Agent's report

stories.title: Speculation
stories.text: "...During the third interrogation, Asuka Shikinami Langley gave the same testimony as the last two interrogations—her identity is that of an Evangelion unit pilot from another world, tasked with defeating creatures known as Angels and protecting the human world... Both the polygraph and psychological experts believe the subject is not lying... This leaves only two possibilities: either she underwent very thorough brainwashing during the experiment, or there truly exists another world completely different from ours as she claims. However, according to higher-level directives, further investigation into Asuka Shikinami Langley's origins is expected to be postponed, and instead, by granting her a certain degree of freedom, her behavior and reactions will be observed to determine her true intentions." —GSA Agent's report

stories.title: Desert Mirage
stories.text: "The superiors have approved Asuka's plan to go to the Eastern Desert to rescue her so-called companions and have assigned Agent Ophelia to track and monitor her actions... Although the purpose of the superiors in approving this action is not yet clear, information collected from other operatives indicates that Asuka Shikinami Langley has indeed two lost companions. They also come from the "other world" and are Evangelion unit pilots who fight against alien creatures known as Angels. From this scattered information, it can be inferred that the higher-ups may have already accepted the claims of these suspicious individuals. Regardless, the investigation has finally made some progress... The truth about their origins will come to light eventually." — Report from an Investigator of the GSA

stories.title: Exploration Terminated
stories.text: "Due to the impending Leviathan operation in Milthus, the investigation into these ‘visitors' has been abruptly put on hold. The precise meanings of concepts like ‘Evangelion' and ‘Angel' in their language are still to be determined. However, since the higher-ups have already permitted them to take a central role in such a crucial battle, there might not be a need for further investigation into these matters... But does another world truly exist in this universe, completely different from ours? There is still much worth exploring." — Report from the GSA Agent

10103150.introduction: Rei Ayanami, the Evangelion Unit-00 pilot from another world, and the First Child of Evangelion. She is quiet and reserved, rarely speaking, but always steps up in battle to protect her allies. During the Leviathan invasion on Milkhama Island, Rei Ayanami performed a crucial role, learning to pilot Arashium STs and, under extreme circumstances, protecting her teammates.

stories.title: A Calm Girl
stories.text: "It's hard to imagine how a girl her age managed to master so many abilities and tactical skills for piloting STs... When she appeared on the battlefield, we thought we were going to rescue her, but in the end, she was the one who protected us... Although I know that piloting STs has become an instinct deeply ingrained in the blood of the Milkhaman people, a gifted girl like her really is rare... Could she be the rumored special experimental subject that escaped from the laboratory in West Milkhama?" — Account of a DLAF soldier

stories.title: Otherworldly Visitor
stories.text: "Officer Matilda says she and her companions come from a completely different alternate world... Is this official statement for real? That said, judging by how they fight, the official explanation somehow seems credible. I wonder what a state their world must be in for such young children to be piloting STs. Not that the situation here is much better... I hope we see peace again soon. Then maybe they can get back the childhood that was stolen from them." — Account of a DLAF soldier

stories.title: Dogged Stand
stories.text: "I've read Lieutenant Hardaway's combat report. In the battle against that Leviathan, she managed to stand her ground for so long, solo! It's unbelievable. Even seasoned pilots wouldn't remain so calm in such an environment, right? Was it her determination to protect her comrades that kept her going? I'm curious to know if they faced battles every day in their original world, just like in Milkhama, and what kind of enemies they encountered... The latest news says Commander Matilda disobeyed orders and went to rescue them. I hope they can defeat the enemy and return safely." — Account of a DLAF soldier

stories.title: At All Costs
stories.text: "I heard that the Logistics Equipment Department and Obsidian have created a special ST for this child so she can participate in the decisive battle at Milthus Port... I'm not sure whether to envy or to pity her. I heard that in her original world, she piloted something much larger than ours, an Evangelion unit or something... Imagine if we brought one of those over here... But in any case, going to the battlefield is a dangerous thing. We can't afford to slack off. We have to give it our all to defeat Leviathan!" — Account of a DLAF soldier

10103151.introduction: Shinji Ikari, the Evangelion Unit-01 pilot from another world, and the Third Child of Evangelion. A boy who seeks recognition as he fights endlessly against creatures known as Angels. After arriving in Milkhama, Shinji Ikari escaped the Leviathan crisis under Dean Knight's protection. After a series of wild adventures, he and his companions defeated the invading Leviathan.

stories.title: Timid Youth
stories.text: "When I found Shinji, he was curled up with his legs trapped under rubble, neither calling for help nor attempting to escape, even though the enemy was closing in. Honestly, I'd never met a boy who reacted like that to such imminent danger. But in that split-second, I didn't have time to think. All I could do was rush to his side and take the brunt of the enemy fire. Then, during a lull in Leviathan's assault, I opened the cockpit to let him in... Luckily, I had fine-tuned this prototype before the battle. Otherwise that ambush would've been the end of us both..." —Excerpt from Dean Knight's interview record

stories.title: Ideal Life
stories.text: "After coming back, that kid told me he was actually a pilot for something called an Evangelion unit, and his duty was to fight invaders known as Angels to protect humanity... When he first said it, I thought the terror of battle must made him lose it. But as his description became more detailed, I began to think... is this true? I have to say, as a warrior, I was green with envy! Piloting a giant humanoid machine, defeating invaders to safeguard humanity—that's the life I've always dreamed of! Yet, when he talked about it, he did not do so with enthusiasm or passion. Makes me think that behind those experiences there's a dark burden that I can't even imagine.." —Excerpt from Dean Knight's Interview Record

stories.title: Never Alone
stories.text: "What lay ahead surpassed anything I could've imagined; I never could've guessed there was such a vast expanse within Leviathan... After fighting together, Shinji started to talk a bit more, but the dangers surrounding us only grew... I also began to understand the heavy burden he carried... Forced to pilot the ST to fulfull the demands of others, he had no way to connect to the world except through the machine... I must admit, I had never even considered what a world without STs might be like. But I told Shinji that in Milkhama, in this world where everyone has to pilot STs to fight, he will never be alone. We're all comrades, and we'll always stand by him!" —Excerpt from Dean Knight's Interview Record

stories.title: Final Battle
stories.text: "The battle plan for the showdown with Leviathan had been set. I honestly thought Shinji wouldn't wake up in time for the final battle, but to my surprise, when I rushed to the hangar, he was already there! The kid really keeps you on your toes... I must say, Major Matilda is really playing favorites—she actually made custom STs for this guy and his two companions. Even the paintwork is cool! You know, I had to pester the old guys in the tech department for months just to get approved to pilot that Steel Puppet Test Type! But... well, this battle is a matter of life and death, and if your gear isn't just right, then forget about winning. Now all that's left is to pray for a bit of luck!" —Excerpt from Dean Knight's Interview Record

10103152.introduction:
Fregata Oasis, an ST pilot from another world and a core member of the Donau Corporation. In the Donau Corporation, if Madland is the flag that unites everyone, then Fregata is the unyielding flagpole beneath it. 
Besides her excellent combat abilities, Fregata is also the matriarch of the team. She not only knows the team members' situations inside out but makes thoughtful arrangements tailored to each person, perfectly handling many "internal affairs" that even Madland finds tricky. Together they form a superb combination of "external and internal." Fregata's confidence stems from her individual strength. As a modified human, Fregata possesses extraordinary reaction speeds, allowing her to quickly adapt to almost any battlefield. After arriving on Milkhama, Fregata continues her usual style—clean, decisive, and strong-willed. In the intricate web of traps laid by Zeke Steel, she seized upon the faintest clues and ultimately broke the deadlock. Her blunt, uncompromising personality leaves a deep impression on anyone who works alongside her.

stories.title: Converging River
stories.text: "It's probably a coincidence, but Miss Fregata also has experience with the rebels. In the past, Miss Fregata was a member of the resistance group 'River of Confluence' and, like us, went through various hardships and farewells... No wonder she gets along so well with everyone in the Ashes. From combat guerrilla to ST deployment, just listening to Miss Fregata talk about her past experiences can yield a lot of valuable insights... I remember Mr. Yevgeny once said, 'For the rebels, STs, firepower, and external support are not necessities. What truly matters is knowing that you are doing the right thing'... In Miss Fregata, I can feel the weight of those words." —Chloe Schmidt's Account

stories.title: Crimson Shadow
stories.text: "...As seen in the combat records, the target, Fregata, is an exceptional pilot. No, to be precise, she has reached a level that requires close monitoring. Her reaction speed, her piloting skills... her performance generally far exceeds the standards of regular pilots, with data metrics comparable to those of test subjects. Moreover, the target's bad-tempered and impulsive behavior makes her undoubtedly a potential threat to the UNCS. Furthermore, researchers from the Technical Institute have secretly sampled the target's hair, and the test report... is quite bizarre. In the words of these researchers, 'Her body has already gone far beyond the realm of humanity.'" —Report from a GSA Agent

stories.title: Her Past
stories.text: "Miss Oasis's body is indeed somewhat unique... I also noticed it inadvertently while bandaging her wounds after that battle. Unlike a normal person, Miss Oasis's skin has many seams that are impossible to ignore, and beneath the wounds is a metallic skeleton and blood vessels like circuits... After noticing my gaze, Miss Oasis had no intention of hiding anything and openly told me the secret behind it—'I didn't want to become like this either, but I had no choice When I opened my eyes, I had already been made into the living core of some weapon, and my past memories and life had been turned into a tangled mess'... I still remember the look in Miss Oasis's eyes when she spoke of the past, there was anger, bitterness, and disdain, but not a trace of regret. When I asked her the reason, she simply continued, 'We can only live in the present. Instead of reminiscing about what we've lost, it's better to think about what we still have.' I think this is probably why Miss Oasis is always so decisive in her actions. Besides moving forward, she has nothing left..." —Celine Reynolds's Personal Diary

stories.title: Projected Future
stories.text: "The records left by the Zeke Steel Laboratory have been completed, which means that the research on Fregata and that ST has come to an end.
